description: Gunilla and her friend Nora move in together. They are planning a threesome with Nora's boyfriend. Downstairs lives Britt. She is renovating antique toys.

Title: Hot Hungry School Girls
description: Five vignettes around the theme of what can happen when teenagers' parents are away from home ... and then return unexpectedly.

Title: Hammer
description: A Los Angeles dock worker becomes a boxer but his crooked manager is involved in various rackets and he's working for the mob.

Title: Get to Know Your Rabbit
description: A young business executive hates the direction his life is taking, and decides to make some changes. He becomes a struggling (but happy) tap-dancing magician. His old boss is financially ruined, but finds a way to bounce back by commercialising his career change.

Title: Together for Days
description: A Black radical activist and a young White woman find themselves drawn to one another during the politically and racially-charged atmosphere of early 1970s America.

Title: I Am Frigid... Why?
description: Doris, forcibly initiated into incest by brother Eric and sister-in-law Carla, seeks to overcome her trauma through diverse sexual encounters.

Title: The Erotomaniac Daimyo
description: Kiyohime, a daughter of Tokugawa Ienari is married-off to Tadateru Ogura, the lord of a Kyushu clan. However, the lord's sexual inexperience and Kiyohime's strict morals lead to significant crisis in their marriage. To improve his sexual prowess, the lord is introduced to Sandra, a French woman held captive by usurer-smuggler Hatakaya. This results in the lord's choosing Sandra as his mistress. Kiyohime's attendants see this move as an insult and have Sandra beaten and imprisoned. Nevertheless, Sandra escapes with the help of Morita, a retainer of the lord. Out of bitterness and as some sort of revenge, the lord imposes a sex ban on his subjects.

Title: Full Time Females
description: Stéfanie, nursing an old man in a nice country villa, has been killed by young men; they will try to replace her with a double; when she finally gets suspicious they plan to kill her too.

Title: Melinda
description: Frankie Parker, a womanizing DJ in LA, meets new girl in town, Melinda, falling hard for her. When she's murdered in his apartment, he is framed for it - an ex-girlfriend and a karate class to help find her killer and clear his name.

Title: The Other Side of Underneath
description: Jane Arden's surreal take on a group of females in a therapy session.

Title: Massage Parlor '73
description: France, a reporter working from an international news agency, manages to be paid to visit all of Munich's massage parlors. He wants to find the whereabouts of Sonia, a personal masseuse with whom he experienced perfect bliss.

Title: Rage
description: An accidental nerve gas leak by the military kills not only a rancher's livestock, but also his son. When he tries to hold the military accountable for their actions, he runs up against a wall of silence.

Title: A.A.A. Masseuse, Good-Looking, Offers Her Services
description: Young Cristina runs away from home to satisfy her desire for independence and money, much to her father's disappointment. She becomes a call girl, but soon after meeting a pimp called Oskar, some of her new clients meet an untimely demise.

Title: They Only Kill Their Masters
description: California small town police chief investigates a suspicious death involving the victim's own dog that presumably killed its owner.

Title: Felix si Otilia
description: A large family and it's many generations vie for advantage, seeking to win the inheritance sure to be left behind by a wealthy older man of the clan. Along the way, stories of friendship, love and rivalry emerge.

Title: Camorra
description: The fast career of a young Neapolitan among contraband, gambling dens, bribes and illegality. He will upgrade its rank till the maximum level of the "Family".

Title: Class of '74
description: Four young modern women in college set out to explore all that life has to give with various new relationships and to study the ones they have been exposed to in their past.

Title: Private School Girls
description: The caretaker of a girls' school is charged with lewd behavior, and a number of students testify at the trial.

Title: Trouble Man
description: A neighborhood "problem solver" is framed for murder by a couple of local crime bosses trying to get him out of the way.

Title: The Mind Snatchers
description: A German scientist works on a way of quelling overly aggressive soldiers by developing implants that directly stimulate the pleasure centers of the brain.

Title: Lone Wolf and Cub: Baby Cart to Hades
description: Ogami Itto volunteers to be tortured by the yakuza to save a prostitute and is hired by their leader to kill an evil chamberlain.

Title: Oh! Calcutta!
description: Based on the controversial off-Broadway musical comedy revue, "Oh! Calcutta! is a series of musical numbers about sex and sexual mores. Most of the skits feature one or more performers in either a state of undress, simulating sex, or both.

Title: Sonny and Jed
description: A vulgar Mexican social bandit reluctantly takes on an aspiring young outlaw as his partner in crime and love, all while the duo is pursued by a vengeful sheriff and bounty hunters.

Title: Sambizanga
description: A man is wrongfully arrested and tortured to death after he is suspected of being part of a revolutionary group.

Title: Siddhartha
description: The story of a young Indian who embarks upon a journey to find the meaning of existence. Based on the novel by Hermann Hesse.

Title: Byleth: The Demon of Incest
description: A man who's been in love with his sister since childhood returns after a year's absence to find she has married. Soon, several women in the area start turning up dead with strange wounds on their necks.

Title: Campus Swingers
description: A fake documentary about the sex lives of teenage girls.

Title: Morbo
description: This Spanish thriller tells the story of two newlyweds and the uncanny happenings that attend their low-budget honeymoon.

Title: Salome
description: A psychedelic re-telling of the biblical story. Salome is the daughter of the second wife of King Herod. The King is infatuated with her and after she fails to seduce the prophet John (The Baptist) she dances for the King in order to ask for his execution. The story is told in a bizarre way of fast cuts, repetitive dialogue and extreme satire.

Title: Sitting Target
description: Imprisoned Harry Lomart is a vicious, brute of a man and yet he is prepared to do his long jail term as he is confident that on his release his beautiful wife Pat will be waiting for him, but a visit from Pat brings him his worst nightmare.

Title: The Goalie's Anxiety at the Penalty Kick
description: Goalkeeper Josef Bloch is ejected during a game for foul play. He leaves the field and goes to spend the night with a cinema cashier.

Title: Sweet Talker
description: Traditional love story of a ladies' man falling for an ingenue from the village and discovering what true love is.

Title: Bawarchi
description: A dysfunctional middle-class family is transformed due to the influence of their new multi-talented household servant - but he might be too good to be true.

Title: Alfredo, Alfredo
description: Alfredo, a timid young Italian, lusts after and woos the beautiful Maria Rosa. But when he manages to marry her, he discovers life is not nearly so blissful as he expected.

Title: Hairpin Circus
description: A retired racing champion, now a driving instructor, gets involved with the speed tribes after impulsively taking to the streets to relive his former glory.

Title: Fiorina la vacca
description: The story of a cow named Fiorina, sold by a farmer to seek his fortune as a mercenary. From here the cow will changing hands, sometimes legitimately, sometimes not.

Title: Morgiana
description: Klara and Viktoria are sisters. Their father dies, leaving most of his property to Klara. When Klara becomes involved with a man that her sister loves, Viktoria begins to plot her murder.

Title: Black Gunn
description: A black militant group robs a Mafia bookie joint and also steals the incriminating ledgers which, in turn, prompts retaliation from the mob.

Title: Stanley
description: A young Seminole Indian uses his rattlesnake to take revenge on all those he believes have wronged him.

Title: The Boxer from Shantung
description: Leaving the poverty of his life in Shantung to seek a better one in Shanghai, a lowly martial artist is inspired by another kung fu master who moved to Shanghai and became a highly respected gangster, so he follows in his footsteps.

Title: Marjoe
description: This Oscar-winning documentary explores the life of one-time child evangelist and faith healer Marjoe Gortner. The son of professional evangelists, Gortner was preaching on the Southern tent-revival circuit by the age of 3.

Title: Die dressierte Frau
description: An episodic battle of the sexes.

Title: Samadhi
description: Lakhan Singh gives his life of a Dacoit and lives a happy life with his wife Champa when his son Jaswant becomes three years old, Champa becomes ill with cancer and circumstances force him to be again a Dacoit.

Title: Forbidden Decameron
description: The young Ferruccio, after departing from Florence to bring a message to Abbot Gianni, welcomes the invitation to enter a convent and become a friar.

Title: Beautiful Antonia, First a Nun Then a Demon
description: To spite her father, a young woman enters a convent. However, the woman's old boyfriend shows up and tries to win her back.

Title: Whoever Slew Auntie Roo?
description: A demented widow lures unsuspecting children into her mansion in a bizarre "Hansel and Gretel" twist.

Title: La vie rêvée
description: Two twenty-something women dream of the ideal man and slowly realize that reality is very different from their fantasies.

Title: Amar Prem
description: A village woman abandoned by her husband is forced into prostitution in Kolkata and forms nameless yet strong relations with a wealthy patron as well as an abused boy in the neighbourhood.

Title: Portnoy's Complaint
description: The movie chronicles a young man's (Richard Benjamin) love and passion in his own kinky way.

Title: Smil mand!
description: Teenage Ole is sent to boarding school by his single mother so he can learn more about life as he goes through puberty. But he finds the other boys just have their own problems.

Title: King, Queen, Knave
description: Adopted by his rich uncle from Germany, British teenager Frank falls in-love with his uncle's Italian wife Martha, and has conflicting feelings when she suggests he should kill his uncle in order to have her and the family fortune.

Title: Metti lo diavolo tuo ne lo mio inferno
description: Riccardo is a charismatic small town's playboy who encourages all his friends to have an affair with all the married and maiden women in town, including the wife of the mayor. Lots of debauchery ensues.

Title: Madame Sin
description: A C.I.A. Agent is used as a pawn in an insane woman's plan to steal a Polaris submarine.

Title: Contemporary History of Rape in Japan
Pancho Villa
description: A double-cross in an arms deal prompts Mexican revolutionary Pancho Villa to raid a US Army weapons depot in Columbus, New Mexico.

Title: The Crimes of the Black Cat
description: A blind pianist overhears a conversation in a nightclub, and is determined to figure out who is responsible for a string of strange murders involving a black cat.

Title: Lone Wolf and Cub: Baby Cart in Peril
description: Ogami is hired to kill a tattooed female assassin. Gunbei Yagyu, an enemy samurai, happens upon Ogami's son, and sees his chance for revenge.

Title: Red Psalm
description: Set in the 1890s on the Hungarian plains, a group of farm workers go on strike in-which they face harsh reprisals and the reality of revolt, oppression, morality and violence.

Title: Money Money Money
description: A group of gangsters are bored with their usual "sources of income" and decide to be creative in making money with kidnapping celebrities and political figures. Very clever and funny.

Title: L'arma l'ora il movente
description: A sexually-promiscuous priest is stabbed to death inside a church.

Title: Country Cuzzins
description: The Peabodys are about to assemble everyone from the clan, including that snobby, well-off urbanite Cousin Prudence. The real fun begins when the merry family from the mountains actually pay Pru a visit.

Title: The Triple Echo
description: During World War II, a deserting soldier dresses as a woman to escape detection, hiding at a farm run by a POW's wife, but is soon hit-on by a lusty sergeant.

Title: Enter the Devil
description: Somewhere in south west Texas, where a christian cult is said to have resided in the past, a deputy sheriff investigates a number of suspicious deaths.

Title: The Woman Hunt
description: A foreign correspondent is kidnapped and used for human prey.

Title: The Brides Wore Blood
description: "The Brides Wore Blood" is a 1972 horror movie - The DeLorca family has been cursed ever since Carlos' grandfather was interrupted while conjuring evil spirits. The curse makes each DeLorca son turn into a vampire.

Title: Gefährlicher Sex frühreifer Mädchen 2: Höllisch heiße Mädchen
description: The young Eva breaks out of her petty-bourgeois home in the Bavarian province and experiences a "bed career".

Title: The Mattei Affair
description: An Italian industrialist died in a plane crash. An accident or an assassination?

Title: Black Girl
description: An aspiring dancer and her wicked sisters resent their mother's love for a foster daughter.

Title: Girls on the Road
description: Two girls on their way to a hippie encounter session pick up a crazed Vietnam veteran, who might just be the serial killer who is murdering hippies in the area.

Title: The Adventures of Barry McKenzie
description: Young Australian, Barry McKenzie, travels to England with his Aunt Edna after his father dies and a request is revealed in his will.

Title: The Class Reunion
description: A high-school reunion held at a hotel serves as an excuse for some alumni to resume old relationships and start new ones--sometimes with several people at once.

Title: Skyjacked
description: A Vietnam vet bomber hijacks a Boeing 707, forcing the crew to fly to Russia amidst tensions and stereotypes of the early 1970s.

Title: Street of a Thousand Pleasures
description: An American scientist prevents an assassination attempt on an oil sheik, who opens the gates of his harem to his saviour. There, nude girls invite him to explore their bodies. But has anyone escaped from the street of a thousand pleasures?

Title: Decamerone '300
description: The squire John Attelano is eager to put his son Falcotto on track, makes him marry Firdalba, the Rampaldi daughter. The newlyweds will receive 15,000 florins on condition that she reaches the altar a virgin.

Title: The Honkers
description: An over-the-hill rodeo champion is so self-centered that he ignores his wife, son, and best friend.

Title: When Women Lost Their Tails
description: Two tribes of dimwitted cavemen prepare for war against each other.

Title: Dealing: Or The Berkeley-to-Boston Forty-Brick Lost-Bag Blues
description: A cocky Harvard graduate transports a load of marijuana from Berkeley to Boston. His girlfriend gets busted with the second load. He and a friend go against a dirty cop and a Cuban gangster to get the load and the girl back.

Title: The Devil's Lover
description: Creepy tale about a sorrowful night passed in a nightmarish castle, so the house of the demon. Many horror elements are mixed with erotic atmosphere.

Title: Neither the Sea Nor the Sand
description: Wife on Isle of Jersey, meets pilot, they become lovers. Flee to Scotland. While making love on beach, lighthouse keeper dies. Incident triggers further events.

Title: The Water Margin
description: Sometime during the Song Dynasty, a band of martial artists form a private army to fight corruption. After trying to recruit two wealthy kung fu masters, one is arrested and sentenced to death, and the other seeks their help for a rescue.

Title: Justine De Sade
description: Justine is a poor serving girl who tries to maintain her virtue and her standards. Unfortunately, she is victimized by everyone she encounters.

Title: Fleshpot on 42nd Street
description: A streetwalker desperately seeks love and acceptance against the backdrop of NYC's Times Square.

Title: Encounter with the Unknown
description: Trilogy of unsettling stories rooted in reality

Title: Finalmente le mille e una notte
description: Sultan Almamud suddenly becomes powerless, unable to enjoy his beautiful Zumurud. The councillors then call people who can excite them by telling stories. At the end of their tales, he will finally be able to enjoy her.

Title: Trick Baby
description: Two Phildelphia con men try to evade gangsters they have conned and cops who are trying to put them in jail.

Title: The Jerusalem File
description: An American student starts working with his Arab colleague while putting all politics aside. However, is his colleague just a regular Joe? Set around the time of Arab-Israeli Six Day War.

Title: It Can Be Done Amigo
description: A drifter with fast fists and a gunfighter-pimp with fast guns help a child claim his inheritance.

Title: Commuter Husbands
description: Six stories that document the awkward sex lives of Englishmen.

Title: Piranha
description: Wildlife photographer Terry and her brother Art go to Venezuela for a photo shoot. They hire Jim Pendrake to guide them through the jungle. However, the trio run afoul of evil local hunter Caribe.

Title: Winter Soldier
description: For three days in 1971, former US soldiers who were in Vietnam testify in Detroit about their war experiences. Nearly 30 speak, describing atrocities personally committed or witnessed, telling of inaccurate body counts, and recounting the process of destroying a village. The atrocities are casual, seem routine, and are sanctioned or committed by officers. Images from the war illustrate the testimony; there's a side discussion among veterans about racism and a couple of interviews about the soldiers' self-realization. The testimony appears in the US Congressional Record on April 6 and 7, 1971. A "winter soldier" contrasts with Paine's "summer soldier and sunshine patriot."

Title: ...And Hope to Die
description: A crook on the run hooks up with a criminal gang to commit a kidnapping. However, things don't go quite as planned.

Title: The Public Eye
description: When a strait-laced British accountant marries a free-spirited American, he starts trying to change her. His wife doesn't keep regular hours, so he suspects an affair and hires a detective (Topol). The wife notices she is being followed, and maintaining their distance she and the detective explore London for 10 days in a game of follow-the-leader without ever exchanging a word.

Title: Lady Kung Fu
description: Three graduated Hapkido students return to China from Japanese-occupied Korea in order to set up their own school. However, problems start to arise when a local Japanese martial arts school tries to run the new school out of town.

Title: The Master Touch
description: A just released from prison professional thief decides to do one last high-risk heist, which could settle him for life or land him behind bars again.

Title: Mannen som slutade röka
description: Young Dante inherits $17M if he quits smoking for 14 days. He hires detectives to stop him while his uncle sabotages his efforts to keep inheritance. Struggle between quitting addiction and greed ensues.

Title: Un pirata de doce años
description: Captain Morgan pirate ship is sunk by the Spanish fleet. He and four companions make it to an island, but the beaches are occupied by the Spanish.

Title: The Man with Two Heads
description: Serum obtained from a brain after a mass murder transforms the good Dr. Jekyll of London into the evil Mr. Blood.

Title: Sucedió en Jalisco
description: Romantic conflicts set against a Mexican Revolution backdrop.

Title: The Concert for Bangladesh
description: The first benefit rock concert when major musicians performed to raise humanitarian relief funds for the refugees of Bangladesh of 1971 war.

Title: Seven Murders for Scotland Yard
description: In this version of the famous story of the London serial killer, Jack not only likes to kill prostitutes but he is a cannibal as well.

Title: Hellé
description: An angry and embittered army veteran returns from Vietnam to his village, high in the Savoy mountains of France, where he attempts to brutalize those around him.

Title: La ragazza dalla pelle di luna
description: Alberto, an engineer, and Helen, a magazine photographer, have been married for a few years, but their marriage is in crisis. They decide to take a trip to the Seychelles, where everything will happen.

Title: Propala hramota
description: A Soviet musical-tragicomedy film by Dovzhenko Film Studios in Kyiv. The movie is considered a pearl of Soviet and Ukrainian cinema. The film is based on the novella by Nikolay Gogol.

Title: Corky
description: A country boy wants to make it big as a stockcar racer.

Title: The Sicilian Connection
description: An American underworld up-and-comer relocates to Europe and immerses himself in the dangerous and mysterious world of heroin production.

Title: Experiencia prematrimonial
description: In Spain of 1972 a student couple decides to test the marriage before marrying in reality in order to prevent a irremediable failure. But this was like a revolution for the catholic society of this time.

Title: Praise, What Makes You Hard
description: In Greece at the time of antiquity. In the year 600 before Christ, the 45th Olympic Games are held, which are all in the sign of the old city-renown Sparta-Athens.

Title: The Night of the Scorpion
description: A young widower with his new wife returns to the mansion in which his first wife died under strange and unexplained circumstances.

Title: Terror at Red Wolf Inn
description: College student Regina wins a getaway vacation at the quiet Red Wolf Inn, which is run by a friendly elderly couple, but it gradually becomes clear that something is amiss.

Title: Molly and Lawless John
description: In New Mexico, a sheriff's unhappy mid-aged wife aids a condemned prisoner escape her husband's jail and elopes with the young and attractive outlaw to Mexico, pursued by the sheriff's posse.

Title: Mere Jeevan Saathi
description: A talented artist (Rajesh Khanna) falls in love with a London-returned doctor, but his past creates problems for him. When that part of his past is resolved and he is to marry the girl he loves, he loses his eyesight in an accident and wounds up a prisoner of a cruel princess. He escapes, and is helped by another man, who nurtures and allows him to recuperate. When the artist returns home to find that the girl he wants to marry is engaged to the man who helped him recover. These songs are still popular: "Kitne arman, kitne sapne laya hoon main dekko na..."; "Diwana lekke aaya hai dil ka karaar, dekho kahin yaaron tukra na dena mera nazrana..."; "Diwana karke chodoge lagta hai yoon humko, sau bar kaha eh jane jahan yu pyar se tum dekka na karo..."; "O mere dil ke chain, chain aye mere dil ko dua kijiye..."; "Chala jata hoon kisiki dhoon me dadakte dil ke tarane liye...";

Title: Wedding in White
description: A father will do anything to protect his family's reputation when his unmarried teenage daughter becomes pregnant because she was raped by her brother's friend.

Title: The Thing with Two Heads
description: Doctors are forced to transplant the head of terminally ill, arthritic racist surgeon Maxwell Kirshner onto the body of African American Death Row inmate Jack Moss because there is no other donor.

Title: Le grand départ
description: A mysterious man, who calls himself Cain, withdraws from the world masquerading as a holy man and brings with him a young girl, Innocence, promising that they will soon reach paradise, where Monsieur Nature reigns. The non-narrative story is an allegory follows the adventures of a man in a cat-mask. He is seen, variously, rescuing people or raping women, or tenderly reassuring a young girl. In short, he is an unpredictable element. He joins forces with someone (Sterling Hayden) who is taking a raft around the world, or maybe out of the world. Highlights of the film are the short scenes which appear with their color the right way 'round.

Title: My Dearest Senorita
description: A 43-year-old woman living in a small town discovers that she is actually a man. Will she change her sex and suffer the reaction of a narrow-minded society?

Title: Savages
description: An allegory about humankind progresses from a savage state to a civilized form, that is only a cover for its innate barbarism.

Title: Wild Honey
description: A farm girl runs away from her sexually abusive father and ends up in Los Angeles. Hippies, LSD, prostitution, lesbianism, a threesome, and a meeting with a satanic cult soon follow.

Title: Chung Kuo: China
description: A documentary on China, concentrating mainly on the faces of the people, filmed in the areas they were allowed to visit. The 220-minute version consists of three parts. The first part, taken around Beijing, includes a cotton factory, older sections of the city, and a clinic where a Caesarean operation is performed using acupuncture. The middle part visits the Red Flag canal and a collective farm in Henan, as well as the old city of Suzhou. The final part shows the port and industries of Shanghai and ends with a stage presentation by Chinese acrobats.

Title: Bloody Friday
description: When terrorists rob a bank all hell is let loose.

Title: Jangal Mein Mangal
description: Biology Professor Laxmi, in the company of nine of her students, and a convent nun, Sophia, go on a field trip in Kerala, Southern India. Upon arrival, they decide to stay there at a Public Rooming House, which also happens to house another group of students, this time all male, headed by Retired Colonel M.K. Das. After several misunderstandings both the groups compromise and decide to pass the rest of their temporary stay in peace. But fate has other plans for them, for Sophia is killed, apparently murdered by a zombie-like creature, dressed in black, who lives in a nearby grave-yard. Before the police and the others could react, a male student is killed. Three male students do encounter this creature, but it manages to over-power all three, and no amount of force or bullets can stop it. It's main motive seems to kill anyone who stands in it's way, including the police!

Title: Mutiny on the Buses
description: London bus driver Stan Butler wants to get married and takes his chance to earn more money when he is given a new job driving a tour bus on a safari park.

Title: Santa and the Ice Cream Bunny
description: When Santa's sleigh gets stuck in Florida, he tells a group of kids the story of Thumbelina.

Title: The Scopone Game
description: Every year, a Countess invites a poor Italian family to play in a card game.

Title: Lehrmädchen-Report
description: In seven episodes, the sexual adventures of highly sexy schoolgirls are dramatically presented in their workplace.

Title: Mecánica nacional
description: A mechanic takes his family to a car race and a series of events occur which brings problems, betrayals, violence and the unexpected death of an elderly person.

Title: Invasion of the Blood Farmers
description: Somewhere in upstate New York, a secretive group of farmers are harvesting human blood for a mysterious purpose.

Title: Deadhead Miles
description: The story of a long-distance trucker and his experiences on the road.

Title: The Killer Is on the Phone
description: When a beautiful actress returns from a short trip to London, a mysterious man begins to stalk her. As she slowly turns the corner, she sees him and faints. Hours later she awakens, unable to recognize her own husband and friends.

Title: The Inner Scar
description: A composition of symbolic, surreal and almost mystic images.

Title: The Cremators
description: An alien life form that is a huge ball of living matter invades earth, and replenishes itself by absorbing people.

Title: Top of the Heap
description: A D.C. black cop is pushed over the edge when he is passed over for a promotion, leading him on a violent personal crusade against criminals punctuated by feverish psychedelic dream visions.

Title: The Biscuit Eater
description: In this touching adventure, a remake of the popular 1940 film, two young Georgia boys team up and befriend a feral bird dog, whom they train to participate in a field trials.

Title: Poem
description: As a faithful young houseboy fully devotes himself to his spiritual duty, his teacher plans turning over his grandfather's mountain property to realtors for profit.

Title: Sweet Georgia
description: Sweet Georgia is the sex-crazed nympho wife of the brutal rancher, Big T. Unfortunately, Big T is an ugly, abusive drunk, and Georgia looks for love elsewhere.

Title: Rivals
description: Peter runs a New York tour. Christine is a recently widowed art gallery owner, and she falls in love with him. But, her 10-year-old son loves her way too much and has an unhealthy and pathological attachment to his mother.

Title: Downpour
description: A well educated and humble teacher arrives in a new city and at a new job in the pre-revolutionary Iran. He falls in love with a hardworking underprivileged young woman that nurses her very old mother and raises her young brother. In an environment where commitments and social problems often stand in the way between people and their dreams.

Title: Cry for Me Billy
description: A drifter falls in love with an Indian girl, with tragic results.

Title: Kalimán, el hombre increíble
description: Kaliman becomes involved in the rescue of the last descendant of the Pharaohs of Egypt.

Title: Frankenstein '80
description: A mad scientist creates a monster called "Mosaico," who breaks out of the laboratory to hunt down and kill beautiful women.

Title: Don Quixote
description: Don Quixote is an unfinished film project produced, written and directed by Orson Welles. Principal photography took place between 1957 and 1969. Test footage was filmed as early as 1955, second-unit photography was done as late as 1972, and Welles was working on the film intermittently until his death in 1985.

Title: Hammersmith Is Out
description: The Faust legend retold (loosely) and applied to a mentally disturbed patient in a hospital run by a doctor (Sir Peter Ustinov) of dubious sanity. The patient (Richard Burton) offers the innocent orderly (Beau Bridges) vast riches if he'll help him escape.

Title: Miss Leslie's Dolls
description: A young college professor and three of her students seek shelter during a storm in the rural farmhouse of a strange woman who collects lifelike mannequins.

Title: Suburban Wives
description: Seven stories of marital infidelity, told from the women's point of view.

Title: Stigma
description: A knowledgeable doctor, (Philip Michael Thomas) moves to a secluded community and soon discovers a deadly virus changing the town's young people. What is more disturbing, is the conspiracy to protect this epidemic when he tries cure it.

Title: Group Marriage
description: Chris is not getting along with boyfriend Sandor and has an affair with parole officer Dennis. Dennis invites the couple to dinner with his ex-girlfriend Jan. At a picnic on the beach, Jan meets lifeguard Phil, who later sleeps with Chris and moves in with the other five. Phil brings in a person, lawyer Elaine. The "group marriage" of the six of them attracts media attention, which brings trouble and prejudice.

Title: The Ragman's Daughter
description: A cheese warehouse worker with wife and two kids hates his dull life. He reminisces about the time he met the late love of his life and the days they spent riding around on his motorbike and her horse committing petty thievery.

Title: The Pleasures of a Woman
description: After her uncle dies, young woman visits his hedonistic widow and her aunt by marriage, Martine, who seduces her and shows her the pleasures of the flesh, which unfortunately leads to tragedy.

Title: The Swinging Co-eds
description: Young women come to Munich for fun and work during the '72 Olympics and invariably wind up naked.

Title: Le Sex Shop
description: The owner of a book shop in Paris suffers a personal crisis. In order to solve it he decides to convert his library into a sex shop, but the only effect is that he turns himself into a sexual obsessive.

Title: The Snow Bunnies
description: Brenda, Madie, and Tammy go on a ski vacation, where they have intimate encounters with men.

Title: The Brain Machine
description: Several people volunteer for a scientific experiment about mind-reading and memory, but the experiment goes horribly wrong.

Title: Stadium Nuts
description: Les Charlots, a French rock group, continue their adventures, in the manner of the Beatles in Hard Day's Night. This is their second adventure. The foursome are on holiday, camping outside a village. The Olympic flame is going to pass through the village. A grocer, charged to prepare a celebration, calls upon the four to help. One of the four falls for the grocer's daughter. However, she runs away after the sportsman carrying the flame. The foursome set of to find her and win her back.

Title: Innocent Bystanders
description: Experienced British spy must retrieve a defecting Soviet scientist from Turkey. When a pretty female innocent bystander gets kidnapped by mistake by his enemies, he feels responsible and decides to help her as well.

Title: Come Back Charleston Blue
description: Sequel to Cotton comes to Harlem. Another bad influence is hitting Harlem and Gravedigger and Coffin Ed are the two cops who will stop it. Charleston Blue was a prohibition era black gangster, dead 4 decades. When he seems to have reappeared, once again slitting throats with his Blue straight edge razors, the two cops begin a complicated search for some answers.

Title: Docteur Popaul
description: Doctor Popaul doesn't trust beautiful women: he says he prefers "moral beauty". Among colleagues he makes a bet who manages to sleep with the most ugly woman during the next year - and wins. Shortly after he meets the plain Christine on vacation in Tunesia. She leaves him after their first night, but by chance they meet again in Bordeaux. He learns that her father is a wealthy doctor who's very pleased to meet him and encourages him to become his son in law. Just on the wedding Popaul meets Christine's beautiful sister, who has the bad fortune to always marry the dumbest guy around. But Popaul knows how to help her out...

Title: Watch Out for ZouZou
description: When a college professor falls for one of his students, his fiancée decides to expose the student's shameful secret to all.

Title: Asylum of Satan
description: A young woman is brought to an asylum to receive special treatment from a mysterious doctor. Dr. Spector does more than just run the hospital -- he offers his patients as sacrifices to Satan.

Title: Diamonds on Her Naked Flesh
description: A female hotel manager and her male accomplice, murder a German gangster to steal his diamonds. Soon, other members of the gang arrive to find out what went on.

Title: ¡Qué hacer!
description: A Brechtian mix of political fiction, real-life footage and Country Joe McDonald music. In Chile in 1970, a young woman Peace Corps worker becomes involved with a mysterious American 'businessman' and a local revolutionary.

Title: La gatta in calore
description: A man returns home to his wife from a business trip only to find a dead body in their yard.

Title: The War Between Men and Women
description: A sarcastic, near-sighted cartoonist averse to commitment, falls for an eye-catching brunette single mother of three, the only woman who can stand his strong anti-feminist opinions, and eventually moves in with her and proposes.

Title: When the Gods Fall Asleep
description: Finis Hominis returns, an escaped mental patient, as he sets out cause corruption and to right the world's social unrest he discovers through the news

Title: Seeta Aur Geeta
description: Long-suffering heiress Seeta is treated worse than a servant by her abusive money-grubbing aunt. Meanwhile, her long-lost twin sister Geeta grows up to be a gutsy street performer. One day, the girls unintentionally swap places.

Title: Arcana
description: A Sicilian widow earns her living as a clairvoyant, in Milan, but she hasn't got any power at all. Her son instead holds supernatural powers and with the help of his mother he becomes a strong sorcerer. But he fails perhaps to understand the real strength he possesses inside and unbinds uncontrolled forces that lead people that surround him to go mad.

Title: Weekend of a Champion
description: Filmmaker Roman Polanski spends a weekend with world champion driver Jackie Stewart as he attempts to win the 1971 Monaco Grand Prix, offering an extraordinarily rare glimpse into the life of a gifted athlete at the height of his powers.

Title: The Legend of Hillbilly John
description: A wandering ballad singer in the Appalachians meets an ugly bird-type creature, is transported back in time, finds himself involved in the Devil's work.

Title: Dear Dead Delilah
description: A sickly matriarch of a dysfunctional family living in an old Southern mansion teases her siblings about finding a long lost treasure hidden in the premises, little did she know that there is someone ready to kill to get their hands on it.

Title: When the Legends Die
description: A young, rebellious Ute Indian joins the rodeo circuit and falls in with a drunken mentor who teaches him the ways of the ring and the world.

Title: Don't Play Us Cheap
description: As an African American family and friends gather in an apartment for a house party, two imps take human form in order to break up the party.

Title: Where Does It Hurt?
description: A corrupt hospital administrator decides to get as much money as possible from the patients by any means necessary--by lying, cheating, or stealing.

Title: The Mummies of Guanajuato
description: The Mummy of the legendary wrestler Satan awakes 100 years after his death, as Satan was also a powerful sorcerer who vowed to take revenge over the City of Guanajuato before dying.

Title: One-Armed Boxer
description: After his schoolmate and master is killed and he loses an arm, student Tien Lung has to learn the art of one-arm boxing.

Title: Stand Up and Be Counted
description: Sheila is a newspaper reporter who returns to her home town in order to write an article about the progress of the liberation of the women. Arriving at the town she is very surprised to see that her sister and also her mother agree very much with the feministic arguments.

Title: Vacation Temptations
description: Massage parlors are sprouting up like mushrooms all over the world. Even in reputable newspapers, masseuses advertise their ability to loosen even the strongest and stiffest muscles. This film recounts stories and experiences from massage parlors in Rome, Bangkok, Paris, Copenhagen, Vienna, Zurich, Stockholm, Berlin, Nice and Munich, which are more truthful than one would like to believe.

Title: A Gorgeous Girl Like Me
description: Young sociologist Stanislas Previne is preparing a thesis on criminal women. He meets Camille Bliss in prison to interview her. Camille is accused of murdering her husband Clovis and her lover Arthur She tells Stanislas about her life and her love affairs..

Title: White Sister
description: A nun falls in love with her patient, who happens to be a communist.

Title: Nobody Ordered Love
description: An aging actress is shafted by a producer who wants to fire her from his movie in order to cast his young girlfriend. The older actress does not take it well.

Title: Devil in the Brain
description: A child suspected of killing his father is imprisoned in a mental hospital. A doctor finds him mentally healthy and begins to suspect another explanation.

Title: Ben and Charlie
description: When, after serving a three-year sentence, Ben Bellow is released from prison, Charlie Logan is waiting for him. Not to hug him. Not to welcome him. Just to let him know, a bit bluntly for sure, that he does not want to hear from him again. His wish will not be granted as the the two sworn enemies constantly reconnect, rob a bank together and go through a million adventures while hating each other's guts...

Title: Bombay to Goa
description: College student Mala has dreams of becoming a Bollywood movie actress; her dreams began materializing into reality when she is approached by Mr. Sharma and his assistant Mr. Verma who promises to take her to the way of stardom. Unfortunately when her parents learn about this they oppose to this and decide to arrange her marriage so that she will be restricted to go above her limits forcing her to approach Sharma for advice who asks her to run-away with huge sums of cash. Greed over comes the duo resulting in Sharma killing Verma; Mala who witness this is on the run for her life; she then board a bus that run between Bombay to Goa without realizing where this journey will end. But her life remains threaten as Sharma has not given up his searches for her.

Title: Sukeban gerira
description: Members of the Red Helmet biker girl gang wind up in Kyoto, where they get into conflict with other girl gangs and local yakuza thugs.

Title: Penthouse Playgirls
description: A gang of white slavers lure beautiful young women into prostitution by staging beauty contests in which the "prize" is a Hollywood contract. The "winners" are then drugged and sold to international sex traffickers.

Title: Ecstasy of the Angels
description: A revolutionary faction steals some hand bombs. While escaping, several soldiers are killed. The movement's highest authority deems October unfit and sends the leader of another faction to take the remaining bombs.

Title: Eolomea
description: Eight space cargo-ships disappear without a trace within three days. And the orbit station "Margot" has suddenly fallen silent. The space council is faced with a mystery and the scientist in charge, Maria Scholl, sees no other solution than ordering a total flight stop to this mysterious sector of space. Her colleague, Prof. Tal seems to be suspicious since he knows things before they are even released. A forbidden look into his personal file brings to light that Tal was part of the Eolomea project that never found approval of the commission in charge.

Title: Koshish
description: A speech and hearing-impaired couple persists through unforgiving obstacles to be accepted by society and live a life of dignity.

Title: Fire in Her Bed!
description: Lovely and free-spirited young hippie singer Donna goes to Los Angeles, California to seek fame and success in the Hollywood music scene. Donna records an album and falls in with a party hearty bohemian crowd which leads to the inevitable decadent descent into sex, drugs, and booze. Can Donna get out of this wild lifestyle in time? Or is she destined to meet a grim untimely end?

Title: Man of Iron
description: In 1940s Shanghai, a tough, up-and-coming gangster goes against an old gangster and his treacherous second in command, and comes to find that when the chips are down, only his fist is by his side.

Title: Under the Flag of the Rising Sun
description: One woman's search to find the truth about her husband's death in World War II.

Title: The Delightful Forest
description: A heroic and honorable young martial arts master is sent to prison after murdering two people responsible for his brother's death. The son of the prison commander honors him and asks him to get rid of trouble in a nearby gambling town.

Title: The Erotic Adventures of Zorro
description: An "adults only" retelling of the legend of Zorro.

Title: The Runaway
description: A runaway girl hitch-hikes west to the coast of southern California, where she meets different people, many wanting to sleep with her, including a lesbian prostitute and the older man initially giving her a ride to Venice Beach.

Title: The Old Maid
description: A shy thirty year old woman and an aging bachelor find a way to each other, after initial complications.

Title: The Olsen Gang's Big Score
description: Olsen has a plan: rob over DKK4,000,000 from an armored car with police escort using a hot-dog stand, some ducks etc. Can the gang hide the money safely?

Title: The Most Wonderful Evening of My Life
description: While pursuing a mysterious, motorcycle-riding beauty, a tax-dodging salesman winds up at a castle whose landlord invites him to participate in a mock trial, wherein he is accused of murder.

Title: Boccaccio
description: Buffalmacco and his friend Bruno Degli Olivieri make a joke of Calandrino, forcing him, for ten florins, to buy a stone that should make invisible the one who owns it.

Title: Dirty Little Billy
description: A more realistic, based-on-reality, unsensationalistic portrayal of the gritty early years of one of the most famous Wild West outlaws in history, Billy the Kid.

Title: The Alf Garnett Saga
description: Based on the BBC television series, and a sequel to 'Till Death Us Do Part (1968)', it tells of the family relationship between Alf Garnett, his wife, daughter and son-in-law, all living in a council flat.

Title: The Boy Who Turned Yellow
description: John and his class visit the Tower of London, where he loses his pet mouse. He falls asleep during a lesson on electricity, but with Nick's help, he learns about it, invades the Tower, and saves his pet mouse.

Title: Parichay
description: In desperate need of a job, unemployed Ravi (Jeetendra) goes to his maternal uncle (A.K. Hangal) and aunt (Leela Mishra) in their village for a few days. His uncle decides that he can be a suitable teacher for five obstinate and spoiled grand-children of the wealthy Rai Saheb (Pran). Ravi accepts this offer, and goes to work as a tutor with them. He soon realizes that it is not upto him to keep his employment there, but rather to the children themselves, who have never tolerated any tutor beyond a few days.

Title: Le moine
description: Ambrosio is a monk who is sexually tempted by an emissary of the Devil, a young girl in monk's robes.

Title: The Great Waltz
description: Composer Johann Strauss becomes the "Waltz-King" and woos a baron's mistress in 19th-century Austria.

Title: Decameron n° 2 - Le altre novelle del Boccaccio
description: During a banquet, the diners begin to tell various stories to be happy. All the novels speak of betrayals and erotic adventures.

Title: Sex Life in a Convent
description: The problems girls face in the unisex environment of a convent school are revealed in a series of vignettes.

Title: Cops Is Cops
description: For a special mission to destroy drug dealers in Nice, hardcore bachelor inspector Campana has to don the role of a married man with a child. He adjusts himself well but will have to fight a lot before being able to achieve final victory.

Title: Tintin and the Lake of Sharks
description: Tintin and his friends visit Professor Calculus at his country laboratory, only to find him and a pair of local children threatened by criminals after the inventor's work.

Title: Gli altri racconti di Canterbury
description: The comic erotic misadventures of pilgrims comprised of young widows, buxom servants, newlywed brides and eager peasants while they travel from Canterbury to London to visit the tomb of Thomas Becket.

Title: Love, Swedish Style
description: Based on news article about a noted Detroit car designer who hired a beautiful girl from Sweden as his maid. Her beauty quickly becomes so legendary that she ends up having countless rich and famous admirers and leaving for Hollywood.

Title: D'amore si muore
description: A group of young people - Enzo and Leila (formerly a porn hero and unsuccessful singer) and Eddy and Tea (struggling with an unwanted pregnancy) - take refuge in the home of Renato, a suicidal musician.

Title: The 14 Amazons
description: During the Song Dynasty, a large family that has produced generations of military generals sees its last male heir killed in battle by an invading army, leaving a large number of courageous women, who decide to go to battle themselves.

Title: Decameron proibitissimo (Boccaccio mio statte zitto)
description: During the early Italian Renaissance and the Black Death epidemic, a group of young men and women, seeking refuge in a secluded villa just outside the city of Florence, shares different stories of adultery and forbidden love.

Title: Shor
description: Shankar a mill worker lives happily with wife Geeta and son Deepak.An accident kills Geeta and damages Deepak's vocal chords.Shankar can't afford the cost of Deepak's surgery but is determined that someday Deepak will start talking.

Title: Nurses Report
description: At the St. Martin hospital in Munich the nurses are underpaid and overworked. The only variety is having sex.

Title: Una cavalla tutta nuda
description: The story is set in the Middle Ages. The youngsters Folcacchio and Guffardo must bring an embassy to the Bishop of Volterra, and during the trip, the two boys meet the beautiful Gemmata.

Title: Grimy's Tales
description: Grimy is a little pig who tells sexy stories of famous fairy tales and fables: that of Hansel and Gretel in which seduction - not witchcraft - is paramount, that of 'Wet Snow White' and the 7 dwarfs, that of Sleeping Beauty revisited, etc.

Title: The Dirt Gang
description: A film crew shooting in the desert is terrorized by a vicious outlaw motorcycle gang (on dirt bikes, no less) who are after the women in the company.

Title: Battal Gazi'nin Intikami
description: Battal Gazi takes on the Byzantium to save his kidnapped wife and kid.

Title: La casa de las palomas
description: The widow Alexandra and her schoolgirl daughter Sandra live together in a luxurious villa in Córdoba, Andalucía, Spain. When Fernando, an old love of Alexandra's, appears in town the two rekindle their love affair until Alexandra finds that he is being paid to be the companion of a rich older woman.

Title: A Noose Is Waiting for You Trinity
description: Trinity is an ex-gunslinger desperately wanting to be forgiven and accepted by his family that he abandoned years earlier. Unfortunately for him, a ruthless bounty hunter is on his trail. The bounty hunter tracks Trinity down and forces him to return to his violent ways in order to protect himself and his family.

Title: The Dawns Here Are Quiet
description: During World War II in a small village outpost, a Soviet sergeant has his troop replaced by an all female unit. As they finally begin to appreciate one another, German paratroopers are spotted nearby and the realities of war emerge.

Title: Lady Whirlwind
description: A young female martial artist reluctantly decides to help a man who is being pursued by a vicious gang, so that she would have the pleasure of killing him herself as revenge for causing the death of her sister.

Title: The Salzburg Connection
description: A list of agents and collaborators, hidden by the Nazis in an Austrian lake in 1945, is sought after by various interested parties during the Cold War.

Title: The Games Schoolgirls Play
description: Lieutenant Ferdinand Hutter is the womanizer of his entire army unit--although he has never actually had sex. A day before his wedding to charming Baroness Beate, his reputation is on the line and his options are to commit suicide or to seek help. At his bachelor party at the brothel from Josefine Mutzenbacher he tells prostitute Josefine--Pepi--his whole life story.

Title: Blood Freak
description: A biker gets a job at a turkey farm and agrees to act as guinea pig for some chemicals that need tested, failing to anticipate the murderous side effects.

Title: The Eroticist
description: A senator vying for the Italian Presidency seeks to cure his penchant for sexual harassment, all while a cabal of politicians linked to the Vatican try to keep the story under wraps.

Title: Shiroi yubi no tawamure
description: A girl falls for a pickpocketer who gets arrested, so she hooks up with his ex-girlfriend and his ex-cellmate.

Title: La verità secondo Satana
description: A man wants to commit suicide due the coldheartness and egoism of his fiancee.

Title: The Man
description: African American senator Douglas Dillman becomes designated survivor of a tragic accident that kills the U. S. President. Eventually, Dillman becomes the first black U. S. President and attempts to end the bigotry standing in his way.

Title: Our Miss Fred
description: Shakespearian actor Fred Wimbush's drafted during WWII. While entertaining the troops with his drag act one day, the Germans capture them. Thinking he's a girl, they let him go. He mustn't break his character until he reaches safety.

Title: Sollazzevoli storie di mogli gaudenti e mariti penitenti - Decameron nº 69
description: The story of a group of monks, who are enjoying the forbidden pleasure of sexual adventures.

Title: Vuk samotnjak
description: A boy finds a large wolf-like dog in the mountain and they befriend. The local peasants think that it may be a real wolf responsible for the sheep pestilence. They decide to kill the animal, but the boy is worried about it and he secretly provides the dog with the food.

Title: Destiny
description: Haydar, a retired tough guy, tries to take revenge on those who killed his brother and sister.

Title: The Sensuous Doll
description: Gonzales, a Spaniard living in Istanbul, reports the disappearance of La Rossa, a beautiful woman living with a mad painter, John Ward. Convinced that Ward has killed her, Gonzales sets out to trap him.

Title: Sex Charade
description: The story revolves around Anne who is held hostage by an escaped maniac from an insane asylum. The fugitive forces her to tell stories to prevent her from getting help. Anne then spins a fanciful tale about a girl's escape from her imprisonment by savages and her longing to return to captivity.

Title: Rainbow Bridge
description: A documentary about various singers, musicians, artists, astrologers, etc., who attended a "New Age" gathering in Maui, Hawaii.

Title: All About Alice
description: A female impersonator leads a cast of non-professional actors in a spoof of the film "All About Eve".

Title: Get Charlie Tully
description: Charlie Tully and womanizing Reggie Peek con two rich Italians out of £500,000, but during their flight out Charlie is arrested for conning an American and a dog. Reggie puts the money in a Swiss bank, and after Charlie is released is about to tell him which bank when Reggie is killed by Sid Sabbath's gang, with whose girlfriend Reggie had an affair. The only lead is four tattoos that are on the girls with whom Reggie had affairs while Charlie was in jail. But Sabbath is on Charlie's trail to kill him, and the Italians contract the mob to find the money and then kill him.

Title: Der Todesrächer von Soho
description: A London slasher pack the suitcases of his victims before stabbing them to death in this adaptation of Edgar Wallace's 'Secret of the Black Suitcases.'

Title: A Day in the Death of Joe Egg
description: A couple uses extremely black comedy to survive taking care of a daughter who is nearly completely brain-dead. They take turns doing the daughter's voice and stare into the eyes of death and emotional trauma with a humor that hides their pain.

Title: Winged Devils
description: The real-life courage and audacity of aeronautic acrobats whose ground life is often as exciting as flight maneuvers.

Title: Tarkan: Altin Madalyon
description: The story of Tarkan and his friends efforts to rescue Atilla's kidnapped son.

Title: The Rolling Stones: Cocksucker Blues
description: Follow the Rolling Stones on their 1972 North American Tour and their first return to the States since the tragedy at Altamont.

Title: Malcolm X
description: James Earl Jones narrates this fascinating and moving documentary about the life of the assassinated black leader through various sources.

Title: The Flower Girl
description: The country is occupied by the Japanese imperialists. Koppun is selling flowers at the market to get some money to buy medicine for her sick mother. Her brother is imprisoned, her father dead and her sister blind.

Title: Superbeast
description: A doctor finds a jungle laboratory, complete with mad scientist and genetic engineering experiments.

Title: The Angry Guest
description: Duel Of Fist was another hit from the "iron triangle" of director Chang Cheh and stars David Chiang and Ti Lung. And, as with all the director's classics, one good hit deserves another, so this sequel was called for. When last we left our heroes, they had triumphed against evil in Thailand. But a vengeful Japanese gangster has their mother killed and one of their girlfriends kidnapped.

Title: 47:an Löken blåser på!
description: Everything goes downhill when french general Pain Riche comes to the regiment.

Title: Execution Squad
description: An inspector pursues a secret society of former police officers who go beyond the law by killing notorious criminals without trial.

Title: The Souliotes
description: As the Revolution against the tyrannical Ottoman Empire rages on, the Souliotes fight tooth and nail to stand their ground. But, disgraceful treason will bring Ali Pasha and his multitudes of soldiers at the gates. Do heroes fear death?

Title: Endless Night
description: Ive is a man on the edge whose traumatic childhood causes him to develop a thing for sex, perversion, violence and murder.

Title: Lysistrata
description: During the Peloponnesian War, two resourceful women, idealistic Athenian Lysistrata and courageous Spartan Labito, declare abstinence from lovemaking until men come to their senses and make peace. For everyone's sake, will they succeed?

Title: The Body Shop
description: Don Brandon, a plastic surgeon and mad scientist, loses his wife Anitra in a tragic accident. He and his assistant Igor experiment with re-animation, using hypnosis to create a new Anitra.

Title: Cu mâinile curate
description: Set in post war Romania, a communist who was tortured by the fascists during the war is now a police detective and sets about clearing his city of gangsters and black marketeers.

Title: Days of '36
description: When a trade unionist is murdered in broad daylight, the suspects rounded up include Sofianos, who doggedly maintains his innocence. When a minister visits his cell, he tricks his warders and takes the man hostage, threatening to kill him.

Title: The Strange Vengeance of Rosalie
description: A traveling salesman gives a pretty female hitchhiker a ride to her home, a run-down shack in the desert. She then injures his leg in order to hold him captive.

Title: The Seagull
description: Based on Chekhov's homonymous play, "The Seagull" narrates the story of a disturbed family and their acquaintances during summertime in the countryside.

Title: Pio thermi kai ap' ton ilio
description: The sexual needs of a sensuous, but neglected, married woman drive her to the red light district when her husband is away on business. She seduces and falls in love with a young man, who stalks her when she tries to break up their affair.

Title: Garden of the Dead
description: Convicts on a chain gang sniff experimental formaldehyde fumes to get high. They attempt a prison break, are shot down by the guards and buried in the prison garden. Soon, they rise from the dead, using shovels and hoes to kill all who get in their way on their quest to get high once more.

Title: 5 Bed Bunnies on the Loose
description: This German sexploitation classic from the loose 70s, originally and literally titled "Precocious Bed Bunnies", regales us with a succession of sexy vignettes presented by the patrons of a club house, in the guise of a socially relevant experience report.

Title: Le tueur
description: Whilst being transferred to a psychiatric hospital, a ruthless serial killer Gassot makes a break and goes on the run. He arrives in Marseilles, intending to escape abroad. Here, he falls for a young prostitute, Gerda.

Title: Deathmaster
description: Quarry is a mysterious, articulate stranger who draws a cult like following of local hippies. Rather than showing them peace and love, he has more sinister plans for them, as he is a vampire.

Title: The Proud and Damned
description: In 1870, five ex-Confederate soldiers get embroiled in a foreign civil war south of the border.

Title: Woman of the Year
description: Woman rises from being an out-of-work actress to the wife of a powerful South American dictator.

Title: Time for Loving
description: The film depicts several stories surrounding an apartment in Paris, and the various people who occupy it over the years.

Title: Zatoichi in Desperation
description: After accidentally causing an old lady's death, Zatoichi seeks out her daughter to atone for the tragedy, consequently getting into all sorts of trouble.

Title: Bloody Fists
description: A band of evil Japanese martial artists want to possess all the dragon herb in a small Chinese village. It's up to fugitive loner and ace karate fighter Jang Wu-dip to stop these nefarious marauders.

Title: The True Nature of Bernadette
description: A woman imbued with naturalistic and libertarian theories leaves her city home to live in the countryside with her young son. There she meets a litigious farmer who fights against the banks and the government, in which she will be somehow involved. Meanwhile, practising her theories, she makes some old men very happy and, by chance even passes as a saint!

Title: Justin Morgan Had a Horse
description: The circumstances that led to the origination of the first American Bred Horse, the Morgan Horse.

Title: The Naked Seven
description: A gang consisting of seven women roams around the country to steal and resell everything that makes money. When the gang leader falls in love with a samurai and agrees to steal guns for him, he betrays her and soon the women are chased by many enemies.

Title: Chronicle of a Homicide
description: During a clash between demonstrating laborers, a policeman and a student are both killed. In charge of the case are a magistrate and two commissioners.

Title: To Find a Man
description: The platonic friendship between two high school youths is explored through the attempts to get the girl an abortion. Her young male friend offers his support and tries to find her a doctor. She is grateful, but has trouble in expressing her thanks. At times funny, at other times touching, this is a refreshing, uncommon look at teenage friendship.

Title: Nearest and Dearest
description: Middle-aged siblings inherit pickle factory, struggle to keep it afloat. Romantic entanglements lead to farcical mishaps as they vie for control. Attempted arranged marriage scuppered by bailiffs.

Title: Up the Front
description: Frankie Howerd stars as a cowardly boot-boy who goes to war in 1914 after being hypnotized to save England. With a German master plan tattooed, he tries to hand over plans to the British.

Title: Love and Death in the Garden of the Gods
description: An old professor rents a mysterious old villa, and finds a tape recorded by a previous occupant, detailing her debauched lifestyle and the events leading to her murder.

Title: Wedding Night Report
description: The members of a wedding party play a game whereby each describes the events of their own wedding night.

Title: As Deusas
description: A psychiatrist lends her country house to a patient, expecting she would repose. But she meets a neurotic former lover, and the psychiatrist gets so involved in the couple's problems that she ends up getting dependent of them.

Title: The Four of Us
description: The relationship of a married couple takes an unexpected turn when the husband's boss gets the idea that their ad campaigns need spicing up with eroticism, and chooses his employee's wife as his assistant.

Title: Robinson und seine wilden Sklavinnen
description: Meet Poor old Mr Robinson who is so bored at home with his terrible and an annoying house wife and her Mother. At work One day, he decides to retire from urban life and spend the rest of his time with three very nice girls on an island. But beware! there's awful cannibals.

Title: To Kill a Clown
description: A couple seeks to save their marriage at a beach cabin, but face danger from their unstable landlord - a military-brat with fierce dogs.

Title: The Sensuous Three
description: While out on the town in Berlin, Raymond sees and falls for Harlis, a star of a troupe of lesbian cabaret strippers. Attracted to a man for the first time, Harlis leaves her long time girlfriend and dance partner. Overwhelmed by jealousy and anger, his brother (Peter) and his ex-fiancee (Ria) are determined to sabotage this budding romance.

Title: The Possession of Virginia
description: The story of a man, 2 women and an inescapable pact made with the Devil. Following a friend's apparent suicide, Paul (Pilon) begins to believe that something strange is going on. Following a series of harrowing events, Paul finds himself at a Black Mass where the truth will finally be discovered.

Title: A Place Called Today
description: Racial tensions arise when a black lawyer runs for mayor of a racially divided town.

Title: Reminiscences of a Journey to Lithuania
description: Filmmaker Jonas Mekas creates an elegiac diary of a trip to his home country of Lithuania.

Title: The Final Comedown
description: Black revolutionaries take action in the white suburbs.

Title: Pakeezah
description: In Lucknow at the turn of the century, a dancer and courtesan believes that her pure soul and body will enable her to find true love and honor.

Title: Beldam My Love
description: An old couple reviews their lives together, from the first time they met and got married since the present, through good and bad moments...

Title: Glass Houses
description: Teenage Kim is in love with her father, Victor, a middle class L.A. businessman who's sleeping with her peer, Jean, while Victor's wife is sleeping with a local novelist. Kim seduces Victor's business partner, Ted, to get to Victor.

Title: Shehzada
description: Circa British rule in India, wealthy DIG of Police is approached by Devdutt, a poor freedom fighter, who would like his daughter, Janki, to get married to the DIG's son, Ratan. The DIG and his wife Rajlaxmi refuse to have to do anything with Devdutt, but Ratan refuses to marry anyone else. They eventually relent and agree to this marriage. Shortly after the marriage, riots ensue between the police and freedom fighters, and as a result the DIG is killed. Rajlaxmi blames Devdutt for his death, and asks a pregnant Janki to leave her house. Unable to stand up for his wife, Ratan remains a silent spectator while his wife is thrown out. Janki goes to live with her father, who eventually passes away, and it is then Janki gives birth to a son, Rajesh. Years later, Rajesh has grown up, drives a truck, and is in love with a local shop-keeper, Chanda, who he would like to marry. Janki would like her son to go and meet his dad, and when Rajesh does so, Rajlaxmi arranges a pompous welcome for him with open arms, hoping that he will leave his mother and stay on with her. But Rajesh refuses to do this unless Rajlaxmi apologizes to Janki. An enraged Rajlaxmi refuses to do so, and asks Rajesh to leave. Rajesh and Chanda get married, and soon Chanda gets pregnant. Then the police arrest Rajesh, for which he may face several years in prison. He is held in the local police station. The truth does prevail, the real culprit is caught, and Rajesh is let go. He returns home to find out that everything is not the same anymore. Chanda has given birth a baby boy, and now lives with Rajlaxmi, and refuses to return home. Rajesh must now find out what compelled Chanda to leave Janki and go to live with Rajlaxmi.

Title: Panic
description: A young woman is nursing a doll like a real baby, and even hears its cries. Her fantasies becomes more deranged and her paranoia never lets her go. Is someone chasing her? Was she abused by three men?

description: José, a young mechanic, arrives in Madrid to make it big. After being conned he loses his savings, and is taken in by Elisa, a photographer. She introduces him to Pablo and Laura. Laura makes him an offer he can't refuse and then his troubles really begin.

He lives with his equally honest brother, his sister-in-law, a niece, Sharda, and a nephew. Due to Akash's honesty he becomes a liability to his corrupt superiors. One day they find fault with his work, and dismiss him. When Akash attempts to assert himself legally, he finds that there is corruption everywhere. In retaliation, even his brother is implicated in a crime, and arrested. Now Akash must come up with a way to clear his brother, as well as expose the wrong-doers, but will he able to do so in this lifetime?

description: This sword-filled thriller centers on the title location-an inn where the down and dirty meet to plot nefarious doings.

Together they formed one of the most funny couple of crooks wich manage to cheat unhappy women and steal their money under the promise of marriage. The film was made in romanian golden comunist age and remains one of the most appreciated comedy till present.

She hitches a ride from ace Grand Prix racer, Ram Khanna, and plants the necklace on his person. He later graciously returns the necklace to her, and she in turns it in to her gang-leader. When the gang-leader has the necklace appraised it turns out to be a fake, and Rita is now on the run from her own gang. She again takes shelter with Ram, tells him the truth and that her real name is Meena. Ram wins the Grand Prix, and both return to India. Upon their entry at the airport, they are searched, and Ram is found to be in possession of diamonds hidden in medicinal capsules. He is immediately arrested, tried in Court, and sentenced to several years in prison. Years later he is released, and finds Meena awaiting. Both get married and decide to settle down and live life honestly. But trouble comes knocking on their door again - this time it's Ram's brother, Harnam, who wants Ram to join him in smuggling. Ram, initially refuses, but when Meena is abducted, he relents and joins his brother in a career of crime - a change that will have disastrous results for Meena and himself.

description: The endless search for pleasure and love by African men and women.

Now is her chance to wrest the key from him and enjoy herself. The knight's portly friend has a similar problem with his equally gorgeous wife. And to top it off, both men have designs on the other's wife -- leading them to devise painful methods to discourage the other from trespassing.

Desiree outsmarts them but Billy accidentally shoots Ben and tells his sheriff dad that Desiree did it. Ben's dad and sons join them in the search party and quickly get out of control. description: Sexy student teachers at Valley High School give private lessons while being terrorized by a mad rapist.

Title: Blood Orgy of the She-Devils
description: Lorraine and Mark enter the world of witchcraft where Mara foretells the future and helps them remember their past lives. When a series of mysterious murders begin to occur, they turn to Dr. Helsford for advice.

Title: Stateline Motel
description: After a jewelry store robbery in Canada, two Americans meet near the US border to share the loot.

Title: Terror in the Wax Museum
description: The murder of a Wax Museum proprietor and some other strange goings-on in the vicinity prompt a police investigator to determine whether the killer is one of the principles who wants to own the museum or if Jack the Ripper has returned to killing after a hiatus of ten years.

Title: Peg Leg, Musket & Sabre
description: A peg legged pirate is searching for treasure with the help of a young boy, teen girl and a parrot. They'll have to fight Natives and his former crew on the way.

Title: Wicked, Wicked
description: Someone murders and dismembers a series of blonde women; unique in that it is shot entirely in the early 1970's cinema gimmick DUO-VISION (split screen).

Title: Charley and the Angel
description: Charley is a workaholic family man who finds out from an angel that his "number's up" and he will be dying soon, so he tries to change his ways and be a better husband and father with the time he has left.

Title: The Knock Out Cop
description: Adventures of the police inspector "Flatfoot" Rizzo in the slums of Naples.

Title: Der Ostfriesen-Report
description: The owner of a failing Munich strip club sends his manager to an area of the country considered backwards to recruit new talent for his club.

Title: Snake Fist Fighter
description: A old beggar from the woods secretly teaches Chien Fu kung fu as he can't afford regular classes and his "dad" doesn't want him fighting. He grows up, works as waiter and ends up fighting men from his town's crime syndicate.

Title: Bawdy Tales
description: In 1850 Rome, two imprisoned young murderers--Bernardino and Mammone--await their execution, passing their last hours telling each other stories of lust and castration. The first involves a duke and a clergyman castrating themselves while the lusty duchess and a lusty country girl are left alone. The second is about a Calabrese shepherd who leads his unfaithful wife to eat her lover's testicles, thinking they're from cattle. The third deals with the castration of a priest by the young man after whom he was lusting. The last story is about a different sort of menage-a-trois.

Title: Kara Murat: Fatih'in Fermani
description: Fatih Sultan Mehmet conquers Byzantine territory, making Istanbul capital of the Ottoman Empire. The cruel Vlad plunders Turkish villages, so Fatih orders Hamza Pasa to take care of him. Vlad captures the raiders and takes them as captives. Kara Murat whose brother is being kept as Vlad's captive, is sent as a spy to the Sultan.

Title: The Thief Who Came to Dinner
description: A computer programmer decides to become a thief. And when he starts making waves an insurance investigator hounds him. He also meets a woman who becomes his accomplice.

Title: Slaughter's Big Rip-Off
description: Vigilante Slaughter comes under attack from Duncan, a local money launderer whose hit-man traps Slaughter in a car at a cliff, but Slaughter escapes, arms himself, and goes after Duncan's hideout.

Title: Kamouraska
description: Quebec, the 1830s and 1840s. As she attends the bedside of Jérôme, her second husband, Élisabeth recalls her youth, her marriage to her first husband, Antoine, life in remote Kamouraska where he is seigneur, their love dissolving in his mental illness and cruelties, her falling in love with an American physician, Georges Nelson, and the aftermath of Antoine's violent death.

Title: Teenage Intimacies
description: A collection of stories recounting incidents to be seen through keyholes.

Title: I din fars lomme
description: Stine is now eleven and her life and world in a Copenhagen suburb's modern social housing is portrayed in episodes around her family, friends and school.

Title: The Battle of Sutjeska
description: In 1943, 20,000 Yugoslav partisans led by Tito find themselves encircled by 120,000 well-armed Axis troops in the mountains of Bosnia and must fight to the death to break out.

Title: Gawain and the Green Knight
description: The medieval legend of a supernatural knight who challenges the king's men to kill him.

Title: Facets of Love
description: A brothel, which was founded during the Ming Dynasty, steams with tales of imperial erotic myths, trysts and twists of pleasurable indulgence, and sometimes violent nature.

Title: I Escaped from Devil's Island
description: In 1916, A group of prisoners plot their escape from the notorious fortress located in French Guiana.

Title: Legend of the Sex Thief in Edo
Anna: The Pleasure, the Torment
description: A beautiful but poor young girl finds all the money and material goods she never had when she becomes the girlfriend of a crime boss, but soon learns that there is a price to be paid for that kind of life.

Title: The Dirty Dolls
description: Johnny recruits teenagers for criminal activities. During a diamond heist, they take hostages. Johnny plans to kill witnesses, but his sister in the gang opposes his extreme methods, causing internal conflict within the criminal operation.

Title: A Super Fêmea
description: Beautiful model is hired to star a campaign to sell a new product: the male contraceptive pill. But it isn't easy to win the confidence of its target market, since people believe it causes impotence.

Title: Tango 2001
description: Joachim is an impotent man who secretly films his friend Stathis having sex with girls from the Tango Club. When Stathis kills a lesbian, the death is caught on film.

Title: The All-American Girl
description: Debbie's boyfriend Bobby has left for Guatemala for three months and Debbie is expecting a boring summer. But then she hasn't considered her neighbors and their 15-year old son Johnny.

Title: The Serpent
description: A Soviet diplomat hatches a complicated plan to enable him to defect to the West.

Title: Bust Out
description: The Browns take their Catholic high school students on a picnic. As one student sneaks to her boyfriend, two others seduce escaped convicts who rape the fourth. Mrs. Brown and her husband fall victims to their prudence.

Title: Sensuela
description: A Lappish girl, the only daughter of a reindeer herder, rescues a crashed German fighter pilot during WW2. The two develop warm feelings for each other during his convalescence.

Title: I Like the Girls Who Do
description: To get an inheritance from his uncle, a young man must make love to seven women in 7 days. He goes through so much to get the inheritance in this typical farce.

Title: No Sex Please - We're British
description: A mistaken address causes a newlywed couple's apartment to fill up with mail-order Swiss porn... right before a visit by the wife's father, a bank president who happens to be the husband's new employer. From the Broadway play.

Title: Mistress Pamela
description: Loosely bases on Samuel Richardson's novel Pamela or Virtue Rewarded, this is the story of Pamela who goes to work in the kitchen of Lord Devenish who is determined to rape her.

Title: When Love Is Lust
description: Emilia, product of a cloistered education and an aristocratic lineage is thrown into the arms of a brash parvenu, who she marries but refuses to consummate her marriage.

Title: Johnny Corncob
description: A traditional Hungarian poetic fairytale that describes the epic adventures of a young shepherd through love, war, magic and death.

Title: From the Mixed-Up Files of Mrs. Basil E. Frankweiler
description: Precocious Claudia and her brother run away from home and hide in the Metropolitan Museum in New York.

Title: Women in Cell Block 7
description: A woman goes behind bars in order to save her father's life.

Title: The House in Nightmare Park
description: In 1907, an actor is invited to perform in an isolated country house, and becomes involved in mysterious and dangerous events.

Title: Two People
