It is not until a new doctor comes to the asylum and determines Markus to be sane, and the head doctor corrupt, he is given his freedom. However, his time in the asylum has led him to become damaged in many physical and mental ways, and it is only through his friendship with an older widow that he begins the path to redemption.

Title: Man on the Brink
description: An undercover cop goes deep undercover to inside one of Hong Kong's most notorious Triad gangs only to find him getting consumed by a life of crime and seediness.

Title: Are Sansar Sansar
description: Bapu produces Tabaco crop he marries Ratna and gets her in his village.The village Savkar eyes Ratna.

Title: La capilla ardiente
description: A young man with telekinetic powers comes to stay in an old house inhabited by two sisters and there he has to face supernatural phenomena that reach their culmination when he is saved from dying by an old man murdered some time ago.

Title: The Chaos Class: Bye Bye
description: A literature teacher who was born in a village comes to Hababam Sinifi. However, the students in the class mock him because of his accent.

Title: Yume, yume no ato
description: A young man starts off on a quest for happiness, he is told to head south by a wise astrologer, He will later arrive at an ancient castle where two mysterious women live, Tsuki, and Yuki, Both women fall in love with the young man, Meanwhile, the young man must face his destiny.

Title: Le maître d'école
description: After having lost his job for having saved a child accused of shop lifting, Frédéric Barbier decides to become a school teacher with some funny results.The great comedy actor Coluche is excellent as a simple school teacher.

Title: Nympho Diver: G-String Festival
description: A village that was once a magnet for tourists to go skin-diving has fallen on hard times, and so the mayor's son gets the idea to hire a bevy of beautiful women as diving instructors in order to lure back the tourists.

Title: Love Letter
description: Yuko is in love with an old poet who happens to be also a married man. She waits patiently for him and only him, yet she is constantly being lust by others.

Title: Crazed Fruit
description: A working class young man, Tetsuo, who distrusts all rich people, falls in love with a girl, Chika, from an affluent family. He has a difficult time, but love survives despite the problems.

Title: Celles qu'on n'a pas eues...
description: In a train compartment, 6 people who do not know each other tell the story of their troubles in love. Only one of those seems to be a positive one.

Title: Blue Lagoon: A Summer Experience
description: With summer vacation, Chiaki, a high school girl, is just passing each day without getting along well with her boyfriend, Masahiko and her first experience.

Title: Grendel Grendel Grendel
description: This is an animated story covering the ancient legend of Beowulf, as narrated in a Monty Pythonesque way by Grendel (Sir Peter Ustinov), the "monster" in the legend.

Title: Une étrange affaire
description: Louis Coline assists the head of advertising of a department store in decline. He has little to do, but seems content with his marriage to Nina, his visits to his mother and grandmother, and poker games with friends. When new boss Bernard Malair arrives to turn the store around, Louis fears for his job; but Bernard, with his numbers man Paul and his factotum François, invites Louis into an inner circle of long hours of work, nightclubs, and dinners with an androgynous vamp. Nina objects, but Louis cannot say no to Bernard's demands, no matter how personal. In desperation, Nina leaves Louis, but that drives him further into Bernard's orbit. Can anything break this spell?

Title: The Circus Casablanca
description: Film about a pair of traveling entertainers and con-men and their problems with jobs, money and women. We follow them in a period there it goes downhill with engagements. It's hard for them to realize that entertainers of their kind are about to become extinct.

Title: Geronimo
description: A YOUNG MAN ASSUMES LEADERSHIP OF HIS TRIBE BY VIRTUE OF HIS COURAGE AND BRAVERY.

Title: L'année prochaine... si tout va bien
description: Faced with Maxime's refusal to want a child, Isabelle leaves him and goes to live with François. The young couple reconcile and get married. Isabelle becomes pregnant. When an admirer of Maxime's appears, Isabelle, jealous, runs away.

Title: A Broken Love Story
description: Fuat is forced into an "advantegeous" marriage to a rich girl due to his family financial lowness. He, however loves another, Aysel. After he loses his best friend, Bedri, he rebels against the system with heartbreaking results.

Title: C'è un fantasma nel mio letto
description: A young newlywed couple on the first night of honeymoon, unable to find a hotel, go to an old castle where the presence of a ghost will make their holiday a nightmare.

Title: Gamiani
description: A countess and a writer are in love with the same girl.

Title: Death in the Family
description: A family gathering attempting to establish just who exactly inherits the family's possessions leads to deception and murder.

Title: Kiss Daddy Goodbye
description: Two children who have psychic powers use them to avenge the death of their father, who was murdered by a biker gang.

Title: Pick-Up Girls
description: A private investigator gets mixed up in a splitting couple's mutual aggression, but after receiving a lot of abuse himself, gets the help of two whores. But with so many women around him, the end of the case seems far - as Mexico is.

Title: Soul Mates
description: Set in early 20th century. Yuan Shih-kai is forced by Japan to sign on the twenty-one demands and transfers the possession of Shandong province to Japan from German. General Cai of Yunnan province decides to uprise and lead a punitive expedition against Yuan. A famous courtesan Xiao Feng Xian admires Cai's prestige and is arrested for covering Cai before uprising.

Title: Sikkim
description: An educational and controversial look into the Kingdom of Sikkim through the eyes of the greatest film maker from the Indian Sub-Continent, Satyajit Ray

Title: Bulundi
description: A college professor agrees to teach the son of a gangster and becomes a pawn in a deadly game.

Title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
description: A troubled child summons the courage to help a friendly alien escape from Earth and return to his home planet.

Title: Tootsie
description: Michael Dorsey, an unsuccessful actor, disguises himself as a woman in order to get a role on a trashy hospital soap.

Title: An Officer and a Gentleman
description: A young man must complete his work at a Navy Officer Candidate School to become an aviator, with the help of a tough Gunnery Sergeant and his new girlfriend.

Title: Rocky III
description: Rocky faces the ultimate challenge from a powerful new contender, and must turn to a former rival to help regain his throne as the undisputed fighting champion.

Title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
description: With the assistance of the Enterprise crew, Admiral Kirk must stop an old nemesis, Khan Noonien Singh, from using the life-generating Genesis Device as the ultimate weapon.

Title: 48 Hrs.
description: A hard-nosed cop reluctantly teams up with a wise-cracking criminal temporarily paroled to him in order to track down a killer.

Title: Poltergeist
description: A family's home becomes the center of paranormal activity that opens a doorway to the "other side." With help, they must cross over to get their daughter back.

Title: The Best Little Whorehouse in Texas
description: A town's Sheriff and regular patron of a historical whorehouse fights to keep it running when a television reporter targets it as the Devil's playhouse.

Title: Annie
description: A spunky young orphan is taken in by a rich eccentric, much to the chagrin of the cantankerous woman who runs the orphanage.

Title: The Verdict
description: An outcast, alcoholic Boston lawyer sees the chance to salvage his career and self-respect by taking a medical malpractice case to trial rather than settling.

Title: Gandhi
description: The life of the lawyer who became the famed leader of the Indian revolts against the British rule through his philosophy of nonviolent protest.

Title: First Blood
description: A veteran Green Beret is forced by a cruel Sheriff and his deputies to flee into the mountains and wage an escalating one-man war against his pursuers.

Title: The Toy
description: An underemployed reporter finds himself literally purchased as a toy for a rich spoiled brat.

Title: Firefox
description: A retired air force pilot is sent into the Soviet Union on a mission to steal a prototype jet fighter that can be partially controlled by neuralink.

Title: The Dark Crystal
description: On another planet in the distant past, a Gelfling embarks on a quest to find the missing shard of a magical crystal, and to restore order to his world.

Title: Conan the Barbarian
description: A powerful warrior seeks to avenge the genocide of his people and the murder of his parents at the hands of a snake cult.

Title: The Sword and the Sorcerer
description: A mercenary with a three-bladed sword rediscovers his royal heritage's dangerous future when he is recruited to help a princess foil the designs of a brutal tyrant and a powerful sorcerer in conquering a land.

Title: Best Friends
description: After five successful years of living and working together, a couple decide to get married. But what they don't count on is how to survive the honeymoon.

Title: Friday the 13th: Part 3
description: Jason Voorhees stalks a group of friends who have just arrived to spend the weekend at a cabin near Crystal Lake.

Title: Richard Pryor: Live on the Sunset Strip
description: Richard Pryor performs his stand-up comedy act on the Sunset Strip.

Title: Tron
description: A computer hacker is abducted into the digital world and forced to participate in gladiatorial games where his only chance of escape is with the help of a heroic security program.

Title: Blade Runner
description: A blade runner must pursue and terminate four replicants who stole a ship in space and have returned to Earth to find their creator.

Title: Young Doctors in Love
description: In a zany parody of hospital soap operas, a new batch of doctors begins their internship at City Hospital.

Title: Sophie's Choice
description: Sophie is the survivor of Nazi concentration camps, who has found a reason to live with Nathan, a sparkling if unsteady American Jew obsessed with the Holocaust.

Title: The World According to Garp
description: A struggling young writer finds his life and work dominated by his unfaithful wife and his radical feminist mother, whose best-selling manifesto turns her into a cultural icon.

Title: Victor/Victoria
description: A struggling female soprano in 1934 Paris finally finds work after posing as a female impersonator, but it complicates her personal life when a visiting Chicago gangster finds himself inexplicably attracted to the seemingly male performer.

Title: Airplane II: The Sequel
description: A computer glitch causes a passenger space shuttle to the moon to head straight for the sun. Can Ted Striker save the day and get the aircraft back on track - again?

Title: Fast Times at Ridgemont High
description: A group of SoCal high school students would rather ignore their studies and instead indulge in their teenage distractions.

Title: Some Kind of Hero
description: A Vietnam veteran returns home as a hero, but is quickly forgotten and discovers the harsh realities of survival in his own country.

Title: Pink Floyd: The Wall
description: A confined but troubled rock star descends into madness in the midst of his physical and social isolation from everyone.

Title: Things Are Tough All Over
description: Cheech and Chong are hired to drive a limo from Chicago to Las Vegas by two shady Arabs--Mr. Slyman (Cheech) and Prince Habib (Chong). Unbeknownst to them, five million dollars of dirty money has been stuffed throughout the car.

Title: Night Shift
description: A mild-mannered morgue attendant is assigned to the night shift, and his new coworker, along with his prostitute neighbor, convince him of running a prostitution ring out of the morgue.

Title: Creepshow
description: Five grisly tales from a kid's comic book about a murdered father rising from his grave, a bizarre meteor, a vengeful husband, a mysterious crate's occupant, and a plague of cockroaches.

Title: The Man from Snowy River
description: In 1880s Australia, after young Jim Craig's father dies, he takes a job at the Harrison cattle ranch, where he is forced to become a man.

Title: Six Pack
description: A race car driver is driving to a race in a motor home with his race car on a trailer. His car gets stripped of parts. He ends up with 6 orphan kids on his way to the race.

Title: My Favorite Year
description: An aging, dissolute matinee idol is slated to appear on a live TV variety show in 1954, and a young comedy writer is tasked with the thankless job of keeping him ready and sober for the broadcast.

Title: The Thing
description: A research team in Antarctica is hunted by a shape-shifting alien that assumes the appearance of its victims.

Title: Deathtrap
description: A struggling playwright invites a young writer to his home to discuss a script, but the meeting spirals into a deadly game of deception and betrayal.

Title: Dead Men Don't Wear Plaid
description: Film noir parody with a detective uncovering a sinister plot. Characters from classic noir films appear as scenes from various movies interjected into the story.

Title: Zapped!
description: A high school science nerd gains telekinetic powers after a laboratory accident and uses them for revenge upon bullies.

Title: They Call Me Bruce
description: A goofy Korean finds his life hopelessly complicated with people continually confusing him with Bruce Lee.

Title: Death Wish II
description: Architect Paul Kersey once again becomes a vigilante when he tries to find the five street punks who murdered his daughter and housekeeper, this time on the dark streets of Los Angeles.

Title: Kiss Me Goodbye
description: The ghost of a dead husband haunts his wife as she moves back to their house in NYC. She's about to marry an egyptologist there.

Title: Grease 2
description: A British student at a 1960s American high school must prove himself to the leader of a girls' gang whose members can only date greasers.

Title: The Secret of NIMH
description: To save her ill son, a field mouse must seek the aid of a colony of rats, with whom she has a deeper link than she suspected.

Title: Halloween III: Season of the Witch
description: Kids all over America want Silver Shamrock masks for Halloween. Doctor Daniel Challis seeks to uncover a plot by Silver Shamrock owner Conal Cochran.

Title: Diner
description: A group of college-age buddies struggle with their imminent passage into adulthood in 1959 Baltimore.

Title: The Beastmaster
description: A sword-and-sorcery fantasy about a young man's search for revenge. Armed with supernatural powers, the handsome hero and his animal allies wage war against marauding forces.

Title: Missing
description: When an idealistic American writer disappears during the Chilean coup d'état in September 1973, his wife and father try to find him.

Title: The Entity
description: A woman is tormented by an invisible being.

Title: Visiting Hours
description: A deranged, misogynistic killer assaults a journalist. When he discovers that she survived the attack, he follows her to the hospital to finish her off.

Title: Vice Squad
description: A single mother prostitute, who goes by the name Princess, finds herself forced to work undercover for the police in order to apprehend a homicidal, misogynistic pimp named Ramrod, who will do anything not to get arrested.

Title: Author! Author!
description: While facing the stress of his original play being produced on Broadway, playwright Ivan Travalian deals with having to raise his son, his stepdaughters, and his stepsons.

Title: Amityville II: The Possession
description: A dysfunctional family moves into a new house, which proves to be satanic, resulting in the demonic possession of their teenage son.

Title: Monsignor
description: An ambitious priest seduces a nun and leads the Vatican into shady business during and after World War II.

Title: Making Love
description: A successful young L.A. doctor and his equally successful television-producer wife find their happily-ever-after life torn assunder when he suddenly confronts his long-repressed attraction for other men. Zach and Claire live a comfortable life secure in their love for one another when Bart, a swinging L.A. novelist, walks into Zach's office and awakens unfamiliar feelings in him. In a move which leaves him wracked with guilt, Zach cancels dinner with his wife in order to go out with Bart. He is inexplicably drawn to this man who seems intent on keeping him at arms distance. Why can't Bart allow their relationship to grow? he wonders. Exasperated, he asks Bart, "Do you snore? Does anybody ever get a chance to find out?" As Zach's absences become more and more frequent, Claire's concern manifests itself in the suspicion that he is having an affair with another woman. Jilted by Bart and feeling alone for the first time in his married life, Zach resolves to tell Claire the truth about himself. Predictably, Claire is shocked that she could have known so little about the man she has loved for so many years and accuses him of deceiving her from the very start.

Title: The Seduction
description: A popular anchorwoman, Jaime Douglas, is stalked by a photographer who's obsessed with her and wants to win her affections at any cost.

Title: The House on Sorority Row
description: After a seemingly innocent prank goes horribly wrong, a group of sorority sisters are stalked and murdered one by one in their sorority house while throwing a party to celebrate their graduation.

Title: Silent Rage
description: A sheriff tries to stop the killing spree of a silent maniacal murderer who, as the result of secret genetic experimentation by an unethical scientist, has the ability to self-heal.

Title: Savannah Smiles
description: Savannah is the only child of a wealthy politician, Richard Driscoll, who is more concerned with his image and career than with his family.

Title: The Year of Living Dangerously
description: A young Australian reporter tries to navigate the political turmoil of Indonesia during the rule of President Sukarno with the help of a diminutive photographer.

Title: Class Reunion
description: It's been 10 years since Lizzie Borden High School's class of '72 graduated, and the preppies, the hippies and the in-crowd have returned to reminisce over good times past. Classmate Walter Baylor has returned too, but with a vengeance.

Title: Hanky Panky
description: Completely innocent man, Michael Jordon, is drawn into a web of government secrets when a girl carrying a mysterious package gets into a taxi with him. When she's later murdered, Michael becomes the chief suspect and goes on the run.

Title: Shoot the Moon
description: A mother of four is abandoned by her husband for a younger woman. Husband, wife and children struggle to survive the seemingly inevitable divorce.

Title: A Midsummer Night's Sex Comedy
description: In the early 20th century, wacky inventor Andrew Hobbs and his wife Adrian invite two other couples for a weekend party at their romantic summer house in the countryside in this paean to Ingmar Bergman's Smiles of a Summer Night.

Title: Trail of the Pink Panther
description: Journalist Marie Jouvet attempts to uncover the mysterious disappearance of Chief Inspector Jacques Clouseau.

Title: If You Could See What I Hear
description: A light comedy/love story based on the life of blind musician Tom Sullivan.

Title: Night Crossing
description: True tale about two men planning to escape from communist East Germany in a hot air balloon, but only if they can take their families with them.

Title: The Pirate Movie
description: A 1980s take-off of The Pirates of Penzance which centers on a noble pirate who leaves his profession and falls in love with a fiery young maiden.

Title: The Beast Within
description: A young woman gets raped by a mysterious man-creature, and years later her son begins a horrific transformation into a similar beast.

Title: Tex
description: After their mother dies and their father leaves them, teenage brothers Tex and Mason McCormick struggle to make it on their own.

Title: The Missionary
description: In the early 20th century, devout Reverend Charles Fortescue returns to England from his missionary work in Africa and, despite plans to marry his childhood sweetheart, receives a most unusual assignment: minister to the local prostitutes.

Title: Cat People
description: A woman who was orphaned from a young age finally reunites with her older brother. Matters start to go awry when she slowly discovers the true nature of her family.

Title: I Ought to Be in Pictures
description: Brooklynite Libby Tucker leaves her mother in Brooklyn to visit her screenwriter dad Herbert Tucker in L. A. She hasn't seen him for years and aspires to find a fast-paced life in movies. Along the way, Libby discovers who her dad is.

Title: Fanny and Alexander
description: Two young Swedish children in the 1900s experience the many comedies and tragedies of their lively and affectionate theatrical family, the Ekdahls.

Title: Six Weeks
description: In this heart-warming drama, a terminally ill young girl strives to bring together her wealthy mother and a California politician, fulfilling her dream of having a family during the last six weeks of her life.

Title: Forced Vengeance
description: A casino security guard is forced into violence from when the Hong Kong mob threatens his friends.

Title: The Last Unicorn
description: A beautiful unicorn sets out to learn if she truly is the last of her kind in this sparkling animated musical.

Title: The Soldier
description: Terrorists take over a plutonium bomb and threaten to detonate it in a Saudi Arabian oil field. A special anti-terrorist unit is sent in to stop them.

Title: The Border
description: A corrupt border Agent decides to clean up his act when an impoverished woman's baby is put up for sale on the black market.

Title: Evil Under the Sun
description: Agatha Christie's Belgian sleuth, Hercule Poirot, solves the murder of an actress at a Balkan resort.

Title: Partners
description: A heterosexual police detective is unnerved when ordered to go undercover with a homosexual police clerk, as a couple, to solve a series of murders in the gay community.

Title: Still of the Night
description: A Manhattan psychiatrist probes a patient's murder and falls for the victim's mysterious mistress.

Title: The Last American Virgin
description: Pizza delivery boy Gary, loudmouth David and hunky Rick are three high school students out to lose their virginity any way they can. Gary falls for transfer student Karen, who gets involved with Rick.

Title: Megaforce
description: Story about a rapid deployment defense unit that is called into action whenever freedom is threatened.

Title: Personal Best
description: The intertwined lives and loves of three highly ranked athletes striving for the national team; Chris bounces between the beds of male coach Terry and her female friend, competitor, and role model Tory.

Title: Paradise
description: In the Middle East in 1823, two teenagers seek refuge at an oasis, where they discover love and intimacy while staying one step ahead of the slaver who massacred their families.

Title: The Grey Fox
description: When an aging, but gentlemanly stagecoach robber is released from prison, he decides to go to Canada to become a train robber.

Title: Cannery Row
description: Monterey, California in the 1940's. Cannery Row - the section of town where the now closed fish canneries are located - is inhabited primarily by the down and out, although many would not move away even if they could. Probably the most upstanding citizen in the area is Doc, a marine biologist who earns a living primarily by collecting and selling marine specimens for research. He is a lost soul who is looking for his place in life. He is running away from his past, one where he is trying to make amends for what he considers a past wrong. But his current life isn't totally satisfying either. He believes that his recent collection of eight baby octopi will help him define that future in conducting research on their behavior. However, he is finding that research is not as easy as he had hoped, and that he is still feeling restless. Into the area comes drifter Suzy DeSoto. She too is a lost soul. With few job skills, she gets a job as what she calls a floozy in the local whorehouse, despite her openly headstrong demeanor not making her well suited to the work. Doc and Suzy are immediately attracted to each other, but theirs is a clash of personalities, despite each truly liking the other. The other residents of Cannery Row do their part for a Doc/Suzy coupling, not always with successful results. Doc and Suzy will first have to find their own lot in life before they can commit to someone else, be it the other or anyone else.

Title: Heidi's Song
description: Orphan Heidi lives with her grandpa in Swiss Alps. She brings joy to all there. However, her aunt takes her to the city to live as a servant girl to a cold rich strict family and their nice but sad handicapped daughter.

Title: Vigilante
description: After his wife and son got brutalized by a street gang, and a corrupt criminal justice system puts the perpetrators back on the street, a NYC factory worker teams up with a vigilante group to find some measure of bloody justice.

Title: Tempest
description: Unhappy middle-aged architect Philip Dimitrius leaves his wife Antonia and career for a spiritual awakening on a Greek island with his new girlfriend Aretha and teenage daughter, leading to extraordinary results for everyone around him.

Title: Summer Lovers
description: A young American couple and a French woman engage in a threesome in the Greek Islands.

Title: Honkytonk Man
description: A boy with a music talent goes on a journey with his uncle for a stage concert.

Title: Mortuary
description: A young woman investigates the seemingly accidental death of her father, revealing many unsettling secrets and putting her in mortal danger.

Title: Let's Spend the Night Together
description: The Rolling Stones' shows in Tempe, Arizona and East Rutherford, New Jersey during their 1981 US tour.

Title: Jekyll and Hyde... Together Again
description: Dr. Jekyll's research on a drug to avoid surgery yields a powder that transforms his timid self into a sexually uninhibited party animal, complicating his relationships with his fiancée and stripper girlfriend.

Title: La Traviata
description: Violetta meets Alfredo and quickly falls for him. After the lovers run away together, they live in bliss for a short time. However, Alfredo's father, Giorgio, starts to interfere, concerned that Violetta's bad reputation will affect the marriage prospects of Alfredo's sister. Violetta reluctantly leaves Alfredo, but his love is so strong that it leads him to actions that have tragic consequences.

Title: The Return of Martin Guerre
description: In medieval France, some villagers challenge a man's claim of identity when he (as he says) returns home from some time in the army.

Title: Wrong Is Right
description: A TV reporter finds himself in the middle of an Arab leader buying two portable nukes, terrorists, arms dealer, a reporter/CIA spy killed, a US president ordering a K-I-L-L etc.

Title: Fighting Back
description: A Philadelphia shop owner forms a civilian patrol to stop neighborhood crime. The patrol's actions are seen as racially discriminatory, leading to escalating conflict.

Title: Penitentiary II
description: An ex-con, on parole and trying to straighten his life out, decides to resume his boxing career when one of his prison enemies escapes and kills his girlfriend.

Title: The Challenge
description: A down-and-out American boxer becomes involved in a feud between two Japanese brothers.

Title: Homework
description: Good-looking but virginal "rockstar" teen Tommy tries to score with some of the local high school girls. But a classmate's mom decides to make a man out of him.

Title: Jinxed!
description: Bette Midler is on a roll through Reno, Vegas, and Tahoe with Rip Torn as her semi-professional gambler husband, and Ken Wahl as a seductive blackjack dealer. In HD.

Title: The Final Option
description: It's suspected that a peace/anti-nuke organization in UK has some extremists willing to use terrorism. The action will probably be against an embassy in London. The SAS/Special Air Service try to get the organization infiltrated.

Title: It Came from Hollywood
description: Popular comedians watch and give comments about the worst and silliest films from Hollywood.

Title: The King of Comedy
description: Rupert is an aspiring stand-up comedian, who is willing to go the extra mile in his attempt to appear in the late night show hosted by his idol.

Title: A Stranger Is Watching
description: The 11-year old daughter and girlfriend of a man whose wife had been raped and killed in front of his daughter three years earlier are kidnapped by the same killer. Held captive in a bunker below Grand Central Station, the two plot their escape while the police try to track the kidnapper.

Title: A Little Sex
description: The story of Michael Donovan's amusing - and doomed - attempts to wield life's ultimate double-edged sword: infidelity.

Title: Yes, Giorgio
description: Famous opera singer Giorgio Fini loses his voice during an American tour. He goes to female throat specialist Pamela Taylor and falls in love with her.

Title: The Night of the Shooting Stars
description: In 1944, the residents of a small Italian town under Axis control flee their homes to seek out the liberating Allied forces.

Title: The Draughtsman's Contract
description: A young artist is commissioned by the wife of a wealthy landowner to make a series of drawings of the estate while her husband is away.

Title: Pieces
description: The co-eds of a Boston college campus are targeted by a mysterious killer who is creating a human jigsaw puzzle from their body parts.

Title: Barbarosa
description: An inexperienced farm boy hooks up with a legendary outlaw in Mexico and both are soon on the run from the law, Mexican bandits, and two families bent on revenge.

Title: Koyaanisqatsi
description: A collection of expertly photographed phenomena with no conventional plot. The footage focuses on the relationship between nature, humanity, and technology.

Title: I, the Jury
description: A PI investigates the murder of his one-armed friend, a PI working on a case. Clues lead to a sex clinic. Bodies pile up.

Title: Endangered Species
description: A former New York City cop relocates to rural Colorado, where he teams with a sheriff investigating a series of bizarre cattle mutilations occurring in the region.

Title: Turkey Shoot
description: In a dystopian future where deviants are held in "re-education" camps, a freedom fighter and an innocent prisoner try to survive their decadent oppressors' game of kill-or-be-killed.

Title: Losin' It
description: Set in 1965, four rowdy teenage guys travel to Tijuana, Mexico for a night of partying when they are joined by a heartbroken housewife who is in town seeking a quick divorce.

Title: Say Amen, Somebody
description: Documentary about the American gospel music scene, focusing on two of the movement's pioneering forces, Thomas A. Dorsey and Willie May Ford Smith.

Title: The Sender
description: A disturbed telepathic man is unable to fully control his ability to transmit his dreams and visions into the minds of the people around him, or even influence reality. A female therapist tries to help him, but his mother gets in the way.

Title: Lookin' to Get Out
description: Alex has had a good day at the track, a bad night at the poker game and hell have a worse time if the guys he owes catch up with him. So Alex and go-along pal Jerry split for Las Vegas...

Title: Enigma
description: A CIA agent tries to infiltrate Soviet intelligence to stop a murderous diabolical plot.

Title: Rendezvous in Paris
description: Berlin 1920: Die seit sieben Jahren verheiratete Anwaltsgattin Evelyne Droste (Claude Jade) verliebt sich in den Amerikaner Frank Davis (Barry Stokes) und folgt ihm heimlich für ein Wochenende nach Paris. Damit setzt Evelyne ihre bürgerliche Existenz aufs Spiel. Nach dem Roman von Vicki Baum.

Title: Come Back to the 5 & Dime Jimmy Dean, Jimmy Dean
description: A fan club of die-hard James Dean fans meet on the 20th anniversary of his death and reconnect, opening old wounds and facing new ones.

Title: L'étoile du Nord
description: In 1934, a mysterious Frenchman returns to Europe from Egypt.

Title: Lonely Hearts
description: In this offbeat comedy, an unlikely romance develops between a flamboyant, middle-aged piano tuner and an extremely timid office worker.

Title: The House Where Evil Dwells
description: A young American family moves to a House in Kyoto, Japan. It turns out to be haunted by the ghosts of a woman and her lover, who were killed by the woman's husband, as well as the ghost of the husband, who killed himself afterward.

Title: Britannia Hospital
description: The chaotic workings of a hospital with staff on strike.

Title: Monty Python Live at the Hollywood Bowl
description: The Monty Python troupe perform a combination of classic sketches and new material at the Hollywood Bowl.

Title: I'm Dancing as Fast as I Can
description: A true story about Emmy-winning documentary filmmaker Barbara Gordon's Valium addiction and her desperate attempts to kick the habit.

Title: Split Image
description: A rising star young gymnast is lured into a religious cult by a beautiful girl. Every moment with the group brings him more and more under the control of the cult's leader.

Title: Five Days One Summer
description: An aging doctor takes his beautiful young mistress on an alpine walking holiday only to find that she is falling for the charms of a dashing tour guide, but there is a dark secret that looms over the couple.

Title: The Escape Artist
description: Teenager Danny Masters, the son of the late Harry Masters, considered the second best escape artist in history, wants to follow in his father's footsteps, he already a skilled but untested magician. As far as Danny knows, his father died in a dangerous escape routine. Escaping from under his grandmother's roof, Danny, in a step to achieve his goal as they have all his father's old professional paraphernalia, reunites with his Aunt Sibyl and Uncle Burke in the town of Harding where they have a mind-reading act, she who actually can read minds but which only impinges on the smoke and mirrors they've developed with the act itself. In his wanderings around Harding, Danny gets involved with corrupt Stu Quiñones, and indirectly with Stu's equally corrupt father, the town's mayor, Leon Quiñones. This father/son pair no longer associate with each other as although Stu aspires to be as corrupt as his father, Stu's activities are a little too brazen and public for a politician with which to deal. In those dealings, Danny devises what is largely seen as a publicity stunt in reality to get the one up on the Quiñoneses, but in which he will have to show his true mettle as a great escape artist. In the process, Danny may also provide some justice for his father, the true nature of his death which Danny learns along the way.

Title: Bugs Bunny's 3rd Movie: 1001 Rabbit Tales
description: Rival book salesmen Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck are forced by Sultan Yosemite Sam to read fairy tales to his spoiled, selfish son, Prince Abba-Dabba.

Title: Movie Madness
description: An anthology parody of film genres composed of three shorts, spoofing personal growth films, glossy soap operas, and police stories.

Title: White Dog
description: A trainer attempts to retrain a vicious dog that's been raised to attack black people.

Title: The Time Masters
description: Piel, a 7 or 8 year old boy, is alone on the desert planet Perdide, only survivor of an attack by giant hornets. Calling for help, Piel's father's friend Jaffar keeps contact with the kid and hurries across space toward Perdide.

Title: Hammett
description: Fictional account of real-life mystery writer Dashiell Hammett, and his involvement in the investigation of a beautiful Chinese cabaret actress' mysterious disappearance in San Francisco.

Title: Cane River
description: The romance between two African Americans who come from a different class background.

Title: Ladies and Gentlemen, the Fabulous Stains
description: The media and disaffected teens mistake the acerbic rants of an obnoxious teenage punk rocker as a rallying cry for the women of America, launching her and her talentless group to national stardom.

Title: Kamikaze 89
description: In a totalitarian society of the future, in which the government controls all facets of the press, a homicide detective investigates a string of bombings, and finds out more than he bargained for.

Title: The Atomic Cafe
description: Disturbing collection of 1940s and 1950s United States government-issued propaganda films designed to reassure Americans that the atomic bomb was not a threat to their safety.

Title: Veronika Voss
description: Partially based on the life of Sybille Schmitz, who found fame under the Nazi regime, but whose career was destroyed afterward. Veronika Voss is a once prominent UFA actress, kept by her doctor, who raises suspicion in a sports journalist.

Title: Losing Ground
description: Sara, a cold college professor, and her husband, an ecstatic painter, spend a summer away from the city, straining their rocky relationship.

Title: Fitzcarraldo
description: The story of Brian Sweeney Fitzgerald, an extremely determined man who intends to build an opera house in the middle of a jungle.

Title: The Slumber Party Massacre
description: A female high school student's slumber party turns into a bloodbath, as a newly escaped psychotic serial killer wielding a power drill prowls her neighborhood.

Title: Forbidden World
description: In the distant future, a federation marshal arrives at a research lab on a remote planet where a genetic experiment has gotten loose and begins feeding on the dwindling scientific group.

Title: Class of 1984
description: A new teacher at a troubled inner-city high school soon ends up clashing with a delinquent punk posse who run the institute with an iron fist.

Title: Swamp Thing
description: After a violent incident with a special chemical, a research scientist is turned into a swamp plant monster.

Title: Sorceress
description: Sword and sorcery story of the cosmic struggle between white magic and black magic.

Title: Tenebrae
description: An American novelist visiting Rome to promote his latest book is stalked and harassed by an obsessed fan who is committing a string of murders that appear to be tributes to his work.

Title: The New York Ripper
description: A burned-out New York police detective teams up with a college psychoanalyst to track down a vicious serial killer randomly stalking and killing various young women around the city.

Title: Basket Case
description: A young man carrying a big basket that contains his extremely deformed, formerly conjoined twin brother seeks vengeance on the doctors who separated them against their will.

Title: Love Strange Love
description: In 1937, in São Paulo, 12-year-old Hugo comes from Santa Catarina. His grandmother is returning him to his mother, Anna, who is now with Osmar, the most influential politician in the state.

Title: Los ritos sexuales del diablo
description: A young woman travels to England after the abrupt death of her brother. Staying with her sister-in-law, she finds her companion soon drawn into a satanic cult based in the house, whose rites seem to centre on large-scale sexual congress.

Title: Pandemonium
description: A former high school student who always wanted to be a cheerleader decides to reopen the cheerleading program at her former high school after years of closure for being targeted by a serial killer.

Title: Querelle
description: A handsome sailor is drawn into a vortex of sibling rivalry, murder, and explosive sexuality.

Title: Piranha II: The Spawning
description: A scuba diving instructor, her biochemist boyfriend, and her police chief ex-husband try to link a series of bizarre deaths to a mutant strain of piranha fish whose lair is a sunken freighter ship off a Caribbean island resort.

Title: The Black Room
description: A serially unfaithful businessman rents a spare room from two siblings to use for his sexual conquests, unaware that they're serial killers who murder every woman he brings there.

Title: Q: The Winged Serpent
description: NYPD detectives Shepard and Powell are working on a bizarre case of a ritualistic Aztec murder. Meanwhile, something big is attacking people of New York and only greedy small time crook Jimmy Quinn knows where its lair is.

Title: Xtro
description: An alien creature impregnates a woman who gives birth to a man who was abducted by aliens three years ago. The man reconnects with his wife and son for a sinister purpose.

Title: Liquid Sky
description: A small, heroin-seeking UFO lands on a Manhattan roof, observes a bizarre, drug-addicted fashion model, and sucks endorphin from her sexual encounters' brains.

Title: Burden of Dreams
description: A documentary following German auteur Werner Herzog as he deals with difficult actors, bad weather and getting a boat over a mountain, all in an effort to make his film Fitzcarraldo (1982).

Title: Raw Force
description: Martial arts students visit an island with ghosts of dishonored fighters. They encounter a Hitler lookalike running a female slavery operation, leading to encounters with cannibals, piranhas, zombies, and chaos.

Title: Parasite
description: In a post-apocalyptic USA, a doctor/scientist infected with a new strain of parasite ends up in a small desert town, trying to find a cure.

Title: Eating Raoul
description: A relatively boring Los Angeles couple discovers a bizarre, if not murderous, way to get funding for opening a restaurant.

Title: Frances
description: The story of Frances Farmer's meteoric rise to fame in Hollywood and the tragic turn her life took when she was blacklisted.

Title: Banana Joe
description: A man is living happily on an island with his family, growing bananas. When a local mobster with an eye on man's property tries to take it from him, he must go to the town for the first time to get some help.

Title: The Plague Dogs
description: Two dogs escape from a laboratory and are hunted as possible carriers of the bubonic plague.

Title: Bloodtide
description: An adventurer hunting for treasure in Greece accidentally frees a monster that forces local villagers to sacrifice virgins.

Title: Passion
description: A film director has an inspirational crisis while working on the production, Passion, and struggles with the nature of work and art.

Title: The Slayer
description: Two couples become stranded on a rugged isle, and are haunted by a supernatural beast, drawn to the wife of one of the couples, who dreams of its killings.

Title: One Dark Night
description: As part of an initiation into a club called the Sisters, a young girl must spend the night in a mausoleum.

Title: Manhattan Baby
description: An archaeologist opens an Egyptian tomb and accidentally releases an evil spirit. His young daughter becomes possessed by the freed entity and, upon arrival back in New York, the gory murders begin.

Title: The Aftermath
description: An astronaut battles mutant cannibals after returning from space to find Earth ravaged by nuclear and biological war.

Title: The Last Horror Film
description: A New York taxi driver stalks a beautiful actress attending the Cannes Film Festival, which coincides with a series of violent killings of the lady's friends.

Title: The Beach Girls
description: Two young women convince their reluctant friend to open up her rich uncle's beach house for the summer to party, and invite all their friends.

Title: The Living Dead Girl
description: A toxic spill revives a beautiful, dead heiress who, with the help of her childhood friend, must quench her insatiable thirst for blood.

Title: Alone in the Dark
description: A few dangerous and delusional mental patients break out of a mental asylum during a power blackout, and lay siege to their new doctor's house, who, they believe, killed their previous doctor.

Title: Smithereens
description: A talent-challenged girl tries to promote herself to stardom in New York's waning punk music world.

Title: Passionate Lovers
description: An impresario falls in love with a young woman, but his wife, thanks to whom he has achieved much of his success, decides to take revenge.

Title: Amazon Jail
description: Edgar, a sex trafficker, sends his men to lure groups of women to his estate in the woods, imprisoning them, and selling them. One strong minded woman refuses to be sold and plots an escape, while convincing other girls to join her.

Title: Space Adventure Cobra
description: After two years in hiding, a famed space pirate with a "psychogun" for a left arm joins a bounty huntress on a quest to save her world, only to find himself battling an old enemy.

Title: Mansion of the Living Dead
description: A group of vacationing waitresses visit a resort hotel on the Canary Islands, only to find that the former monastery's monks nearby have returned as living blind dead.

Title: Satan's Baby Doll
description: In the crypt of the remote castle of the Aguilars lies the recently-deceased body of Maria. Her husband Antonio is a jealous bully, his mute brother Ignazio is in a wheelchair peeping on his caretaker Sol, a novice. Also present are Miria, the couple's virginal daughter, and Isidro, a factotum who fears Satan's power. A frequent visitor is Juan Suarez, a doctor who wants Miria in a sanatorium for a month. She doesn't want to go. Isidro tries to exorcize the castle's evil spirits. Bodies pile up. Is Miria's mother truly dead, and who is Satan's tool?

Title: Humongous
description: A woman's son, born after a traumatic assault, grows into a monstrous killer haunting a group of shipwrecked teenagers stranded on his island.

Title: The Outcasts
description: In 1810 Ireland, a man whose wife has died finds that his daughter is accused of being a witch. A magic fiddler comes to her aid.

Title: Unhinged
description: Three young women who crash their car during a rainstorm are taken in by a bizarre family at their large, rural estate.

Title: Brimstone & Treacle
description: A strange young man has a sinister effect on the family of a middle-aged writer.

Title: For Tor's Sake
description: Thor's father drinks, and Thor escapes to the woods and refuses to come home before he quits drinking. Lucky for Thor he has a lot of friends who help him.

Title: Identification of a Woman
description: A director's wife leaves him. He pursues another woman who also departs. This inspires a movie idea about women's relationships. He searches for an actress to star in the film and his life.

Title: Nightbeast
description: A creature from outer space crash lands in a small town and starts killing people.

Title: 1990: The Bronx Warriors
description: In a post-apocalyptic New York City, a policeman infiltrates the Bronx, which has become a battleground for several murderous street gangs.

Title: Superstition
description: A witch put to death in 1692 swears vengeance on her persecutors and returns to the present day to punish their descendants.

Title: The Inconfessable Orgies of Emmanuelle
description: Emmanuelle is recently reunited with her husband, but at the next party, she gets drunk and strips nude for his friends. He returns to his lover. Later, a sober Emmanuelle tries to redeem herself, but her husband refuses to forgive.

Title: Next of Kin
description: In a rest home for elderly people, a daughter reads her mother's diary. Soon events that are mentioned in the mother's diary begin to happen to the daughter.

Title: Moonlighting
description: Nowak (Irons), a Polish contractor, leads a group of workmen to London so they can provide cheap labor for a government official based there. Nowak must manage the project and the men as they encounter the temptations of the West and loneliness and separation from their families. Nowak is the only one of the group who speaks English, and he uses this as a tool over his team. When the unrest in Poland leads to a military takeover, Nowak is faced with a much more difficult situation than he expected.

Title: Ator: The Fighting Eagle
description: The son of Torren learns of his heritage, goes to avenge the deaths of his fellow villagers, and rescue his sister from the evil Dakkar and his spider cult.

Title: Girls Nite Out
description: At a remote Ohio college, a killer dressed in the school's bear mascot suit stalks several young women participating in an all-night scavenger hunt.

Title: Maratonci trce pocasni krug
description: The Topalovic family has been in the burial business for generations. When the old (150 yrs old) Pantelija dies, five generations of his heirs start to fight for the inheritance.

Title: The Jonsson Gang & Dynamite Harry
description: Sickan, Vanheden and Rocky try to rob the Berns nightclub one night, but Vanheden has made the mistake to invite his constantly drunk cousin, the old dynamiter Dynamite-Harry and he ruins the plan. Sickan is arrested, and has to spend 10 months in a small, locked room. When he is released, he has a new plan, but Rocky and Vanheden have decided to go straight. Together with Dynamite-Harry, Sickan plans to rob a cold store, managed by their arch-enemy, Wall-Enberg.

Title: Malamore
description: Marcello is a dwarf who is kept hidden by his family and falls in love with a prostitute from the local brothel. The prostitute's lover plots to kill the dwarf but she helps him to escape, though at a cost to her own well-being.

Title: Double Exposure
description: A photographer plagued by horrific nightmares in which he kills the young female models he shoots is shocked to discover that there is a serial killer in his city who is targeting attractive women.

Title: Time Walker
description: An alien, buried in King Tut's tomb, terrorizes a college campus.

Title: Wacko
description: Thirteen years after the "Lawnmower Killer" killed her sister, high school student Mary Graves and obsessed detective Dick Harbinger are on the lookout for the killer to reappear during the annual Halloween Pumpkin Prom.

Title: Death Screams
description: In a small town in North Carolina, a group of friends are stalked by a mysterious, machete wielding maniac.

Title: Labyrinth of Passion
description: A camp melodrama/comedy about Sexilia (a nymphomaniac), Sadec (a gay Islamic terrorist), Riza Niro (the son of the emperor of Tiran), and Queti (the daughter of a dry-cleaner). When Riza Niro discovers that Sadec and his colleagues are after him, he disguises himself as a punk rocker, and falls in love with the stunning Sexilia, his first straight relationship. Meanwhile Queti, Sexilia's "biggest fan", helps Sexilia come to terms with her new life-style.

Title: The Fan
description: The hero-worship that Simone has for a pop singer is built to a crescendo until she passes out when she finally sees him up-close in a crowd of fans. She is later shocked when he lets her know that he does not love her.

Title: Oasis of the Zombies
description: An expedition searching for treasure supposedly buried by the German army in the African desert during WWII comes up against an army of Nazi zombies guarding the fortune.

Title: The Magic Mountain
description: Hans Castorp, fresh from university and about to become a civil engineer, comes to the Sanatorium Berghof in the Swiss Alps to visit his cousin Joachim, an army officer, who is recovering there from tuberculosis. Intending to remain at the Berghof for three weeks, Hans is gradually contaminated by the morbid atmosphere pervading the place. Wishing very much to be considered a patient like the others, he achieves his ends and stays in the sanatorium for ...seven years. During this time, he has enough time to take part in the furious philosophical debates pitting against each other Settembrini, a secular humanist, and Naphta, a totalitarian Jesuit. And to fall in love with the beautiful but enigmatic Clawdia Chauchat. When he is finally discharged in 1914 - along with all the other patients - it is only to plunge into the horrors of World War I.

Title: The Simple-Minded Murderer
description: A mentally challenged man escapes from his tyrannical master and finds happiness when a poor family takes him in.

Title: The Appointment
description: 'The Appointment' holds a deadly lesson in parenthood. Ian deeply disappoints his daughter Joanne by having to absent himself from her Big Day--her first important violin solo. But Joanne is no ordinary young girl and Ian finds himself having to contend with rather more than a childish fit of the sulks as a battle of wills develops. Strange and evil forces permeate the household, building up to be unleashed upon Ian as he takes the journey that becomes the climax of this psychological thriller.

Title: Fast-Walking
description: A corrupt prison guard becomes involved in a plot to murder a black revolutionary serving time in his prison.

Title: Wild Style
description: South Bronx graffiti artist Zoro is commissioned to paint a backdrop for a hip-hop concert.

Title: Hot and Deadly
description: Carefree electrician Tom Cathral is recruited by The Company, and is quickly offered a full-time promotion to join the Retrievers, an elite squad of crooked secret operatives. His refusal to kill botches his first mission, making Tom The Company's new target.

Title: Gräsänklingar
description: Gary misses the bus. He doesn't have a car.

Title: Mother Lode
description: It's Silas McGee's gold. He just hasn't found it yet, although he's searched for his mother lode for more than 30 years in the remote high country of British Columbia.

Title: Hey Good Lookin'
description: An outrageous, affectionate look at coming of age in Eisenhower-era Brooklyn.

Title: Battletruck
description: Post World War III futuristic tale of collapsed governments & bankrupt countries heralding a new lawless age.

Title: The White Rose
description: During the Second World War, a small group of students at Munich University begin to question the decisions and sanity of Germany's Nazi government. The students form a resistance cell which they name the "White Rose" after a newsletter that is secretly distributed to the student body. At first small in numbers and fearful of discovery, the White Rose begins to gain massive support after a Nazi Gauleiter nearly incites a student riot after a provocative speech. At this point, the matter is taken over by the Gestapo, who pledge to hunt down and destroy the members of the White Rose.

Title: The State of Things
description: The crew is running out of money to finish their film.

Title: Android
description: A strange doctor secretly experiments with androids on his space station. His assistant is Max, a curious android who wants to see the world and meet a girl. Criminals hide on their station and soon violence erupts.

Title: Ninja in the Dragon's Den
description: Two rival warriors, a Japanese and a Chinese, are forced to work together after their master has been killed by a mighty enemy.

Title: Boardinghouse
description: A boarding house is reopened years after gruesome murders were committed there. Suddenly, the body count begins once more!

Title: Julie Darling
description: A teenage girl whose inaction caused her mother's death arranges a similarly gruesome fate for her stepmother and brother.

Title: Five Elements Ninjas
description: A Chinese martial arts school is infiltrated and destroyed by ninjas. Tian Hao survives the massacre and seeks to uncover the trickery of ninjutsu in order to beat the Five Element Ninjas and avenge his family.

Title: Slapstick of Another Kind
description: Rich Caleb and Lu Swain give birth to alien twins Wilbur and Eliza, who are the smartest kids around when they put their heads together. Events threaten to keep the twins apart and a Chinese ambassador needs the twins' help.

Title: Timerider: The Adventure of Lyle Swann
description: A maverick motorbike racer wanders into a top-secret time-travel research test site which unintentionally teleports him to the mid-1800s and ends up having to fight violent outlaws for his survival.

Title: Tag: The Assassination Game
description: College assassination game turns deadly as someone starts playing for real.

Title: The Girl from Trieste
description: An aging artist sees a beautiful young woman drowning near the beach and helps her. They become lovers. At first he is smitten by her youth, beauty and free spirit but soon he starts worrying that she might actually be insane.

Title: A Room in Town
description: Amid an ongoing workers' strike, a steelworker falls in love with the daughter of his baroness landlady, even though both are already in relationships.

Title: Violence in a Women's Prison
description: Photojournalist Emanuelle goes undercover into a woman's prison, where she discovers and experiences the abuse, torture and humiliation the inmates are subjected to.

Title: Remembrance
description: A group of Devonport-based Royal Navy ratings, due to sail to America for a six-month NATO exercise, go out on the town on their last night in port, hitting Plymouth's notorious Union Street district, with violent results.

Title: Yol
description: The difficulties experienced by five prisoners who took a weeks leave from prison.

Title: Running on Empty
description: Mike is a young man who is a budding street racer, and owner of a Ford Falcon GT-HO Phase III. His best mate and mechanic, Tony, are both steel workers by day, but when they aren't working, they are racing.

Title: The Concrete Jungle
description: When an unsuspecting woman, who was setup by her boyfriend to carry a stash of cocaine, is sentenced to three years in prison, she struggles to survive against the corrupt warden and the vicious inmates.

Title: Apprenticeship of the Inventor Polz
description: Jani, called just Polz by his fellows, is a sincere elementary schoolboy. He likes his schoolmate Hojka, but especially drawn to inventiveness. He is suported by his mother, his schoolmate Hojka and Fitipaldi. The rest of them, on the other hand his father, a teacher of physics at the top of list, show no recognition of his efforts whatsoever. When seeminghly on the verge of his first success, his device explodes and thus concludes his life of home expirimentation. Polz remains a kind of rebel and fanatic in the eyes of adults, but his younger brother is already promising to follow in his footsteps.

Title: Hysterical
description: A burned out writer retreats to a northwest town called Hellview to write the great American novel. Unfortunately for him, the lighthouse he is renting is inhabited by the spirit of a woman who killed herself there one hundred years before and now wants him to replace her lost love, Captain Howdy. When Captain Howdy is resurrected, two daring adventure seekers are brought in to solve the case and find out the secret of the lighthouse.

Title: The Man Who Saved the World
description: Two space cadets crash-land on a desert planet, where an evil wizard seeks the ultimate power to take over the world.

Title: Deadly Games
description: A woman falls to her death after getting attacked by a black-clad assailant. Her sister arrives in town and starts dating a police detective, who's friends with a strange movie theater curator, as other women fall prey to the killer.

Title: A Tight Spot
description: In this light, fluffy comedy, a low-level clerk cannot make ends meet because his brood is in no way economically cooperative: his daughter is a lawyer looking for work, unsuccessfully; his son is a would-be astronomer who wants to spend his life studying without working; and his other son wants his own wheels. It is enough to send a father to the lottery, or to the soccer pool.

Title: Alamat ni Leon Guerrero
description: Leon Guerrero, the Pinoy "Lone Ranger" symbolizes the fight of good over evil and the triumph of right over wrong. Lito Lapid plays the legendary crime-fighting gunslinger who champions the oppressed and punish the oppressor and tyrants.

Title: Arth
description: A film-maker who is having an extra-marital affair with an actress decides to leave his wife. Arth is the story of this women's search for her identity.

Title: Adolescence
description: Lara and Jorge fall in love. They decide to leave their families and live together without their permission.

Title: Centipede Horror
description: A powerful sorcerer targets the grandchildren of the man who burnt down his village 50 years ago, by casting his deadly Centipede Spell on them.

Title: The Quack
description: Abandoned by his wife and daughter, a famous surgeon starts drinking, hurts his head and loses his memory. His medical knowledge gradually resurfaces and he becomes a village healer, not remembering who he is.

Title: The Junkman
description: Junkman and movie-maker Harlan Hollis struggles to stay alive when a jealous partner in his company hires goons to kill him. Full of amazing car chases, fantastic crashes, and edge-of-your-seat action.

Title: W la foca
description: Andrea, a nice girl, move from Veneto (north of Italy) to Roma. She is employed as a nurse in a medical practice. She soon is involved in a never-ending game of misunderstanding, couples exchange, sexual seductions.

Title: Deadly Eyes
description: Contaminated grain breeds overgrown, killer rats in this Golden Harvest production.

Title: The Wizard of Oz
description: Animated version of the classic story of a young farmgirl who is transported to the magic land of Oz.

Title: Bankers Also Have Souls
description: Gregoire is retiring after many years with the same bank, and his collegues surprise him with the gift of a beautiful call girl, Barbara. Thinking she is a conquest, he impersonates the bank president, leading to a comedy of mistaken identities.

Title: The Best of Sex and Violence
description: Hosted by John Carradine, this tape is a compilation of scenes from and previews for various exploitation films.

Title: Litan
description: Married couple Jock and Nora visit the town of Litan during its Carnival celebration. After having a nightmare of Jock's death, Nora sets out to find him but encounters strange people and dangerous events erupting all over town.

Title: Santa Claus Is a Stinker
description: Two neurotics, working for a suicide hotline on the night of Christmas Eve, get caught up in a catastrophe when a pregnant woman, her abusive boyfriend, and a transvestite visit their office.

Title: Talcum Powder
description: Sergio Benvenuti finds a job as musical agent to an important Italian publisher. This could be his final step before to marry Rossella. But his career does not rise, so he asks Nadia Vandelli, a more-experienced agent and a nice girl, to work with him for just one day to gain more experience. They must meet Manuel Fantoni in his own flat; Nadia is late, but Sergio goes ahead with the meeting. By the time she arrives, Sergio has found out that Fantoni isn't what he said he was. Things escalate quickly until Sergio lands in an incredible situation from which he can't escape.

Title: The Shaolin Temple
description: A young man, hounded by a psychopathic general, learns martial arts at the Shaolin temple to avenge his father's death. To achieve this he forgoes a budding romance with his kungfu master's daughter, a shepherdess.

Title: Splitz
description: An all-female rock band and a group of "well-endowed" sorority sisters team up to save a sorority house slated for condemnation by the university.

Title: Kai o protos matakias
description: Simos, a master peeper, gets involved in a sabotage plot against the business-hotel where he works.

Title: Island of Blood
description: A group of actors are assembled in a small island to film a low-budget movie. Soon, they begin to fall prey to a mysterious killer who uses the lyrics of a weird song to determine his method of murder.

Title: The Dorm That Dripped Blood
description: Four college students are stalked by an unknown assailant while staying on campus over the Christmas holidays to help clear out a dormitory which is to be demolished.

Title: One Down, Two to go
description: A pair of tough cops go after the mob who rigged the martial arts tournament and injured their buddy.

Title: Dear Mr. Wonderful
description: Joe Pesci is a small man looking for a big break. Owner of a bowling alley and nightclub in Jersey, Ruby Dennis (Pesci) sets his sights on making it big in Vegas. But Ruby finds more than he gambled for and in the end is a much bigger man for it.

Title: Burst City
description: Punk rock gangs and music groups clash with one another and the brutal police force in a futuristic Tokyo setting.

Title: The Party 2
description: Vulnerable and impressionable teenage girl continues to experience sorrows and joys of adult life.

Title: A Whole Night
description: Following over two dozen different people in the almost wordless atmosphere of a dark night in a Brussels town, Akerman examines acceptance and rejection in the realm of romance.

Title: A Good Marriage
description: Sabine vows to give up married lovers, and is determined to find a good husband. Her best friend Clarisse introduces her to her cousin Edmond, a busy lawyer from Paris. Sabine pursues Edmond, with the encouragement of Clarisse, but Edmond does not seem very interested.

Title: The Big Pardon
description: With the help of his binoculars, commissioner Duche monitors from his car the reception at the villa of Raymond Bettoun, the head of the clan of Jewish Pied-Noir.

Title: Scrubbers
description: A film in feminist reading of the vulgar genre of the 'women's prison film', which without voyeurism tells of violence among women and their relationships with each other.

Title: Mad Mission
description: A "James Bond" type burglar named King Kong (Sam Hui) tries to redeem himself and joins forces with Albert "Baldy" Au (Karl Maka), a bumbling police detective from the states, to try to track down a rare set of stolen luscious diamonds before it ends up in the hands of a notorious European gangster named "White Gloves." The two unlikely duo are supervised by Supt. Nancy Ho, a masculine, fiery-tempered policewoman.

Title: Demon Rage
description: A woman in an unhappy marriage finds sexual fulfillment in her relationship with a ghostly, speechless presence who, obviously, doesn't quite say who he is.

Title: That Night in Varennes
description: During the French Revolution, a surprising company shares a coach, trying to catch up something - the time itself, perhaps.

Title: The Escapees
description: Two young women escape from an insane asylum and are taken in by a travelling erotic dance troupe. When the travelling show is raided by the police they are out on the lamb again.

Title: Chan Is Missing
description: Two cab drivers search San Francisco's Chinatown for the mysterious Chan, who disappeared with their $4000.

Title: White Rose Campus: Then Everybody Gets Raped
description: Three crazed rapists hijack a school bus and proceed to terrorize and rape all the teachers and students they feel are attractive enough.

Title: The Hatter's Ghost
description: Labbé is a quiet hatter in a small town, living with his handicapped wife who never goes out. His neighbour, a tailor, is fascinated by him. A series of female murders shakes the town. Is Labbé involved?

Title: Lady Karuizawa
description: The neglected wife of a rich, abusive businessman hires a disgraced waiter to tutor her young son at their summer house. They become lovers, but his ambition and self-interest lead him into dangerous waters.

Title: Angel
description: Saxophonist Danny witnesses the murder of his band manager and a non-verbal deaf girl after a gig. Questioned by the police, he remembers only the orthopedic shoes of the killers' leader. So begins his quest to avenge them.

Title: Xiong zhong
description: After trying to go straight, an ex-con is drawn back into the criminal underworld when his old gang kidnaps a woman.

Title: The Ghost Dance
description: The spirit of a long-dead warrior possesses the body of an Indian medicine man and turns him into a homicidal maniac.

Title: The Gendarme and the Gendarmettes
description: Cruchot and his gendarmes from Saint-Tropez receive a highly responsible government mission - to ensure the safety of four young beautiful female gendarmes officers. In a few days they begin to be abducted by mysterious villains.

Title: Inclinación sexual al desnudo
description: Beachtown summer sexcapades of a lesbian couple that shoots porn, their transsexual porn director who falls for a man and her female assistant who has the hots for her.

Title: Nomad
description: Two young couples, from the wealthy and working class of Hong Kong, form and soon become inseparable. They start living an idle life, dreaming of traveling far away, when an ex-revolutionary friend in hiding arrives from Japan.

Title: Prem Rog
description: Manorama, the daughter of a rich, orthodox family is married off, leaving her childhood friend Deodhar and his secret love for her, in despair. When tragedy befalls her, and traditions seem unfair, Deodhar must fight for what's right.

Title: Countryman
description: A young American couple crash-lands their plane in Jamaica. A fisherman rescues them and leads them away from the authorities, who have fabricated a story about the plane, involving drug and arms smuggling by the CIA, to gain popularity in an upcoming election.

Title: Honeymoon Horror
description: Imagine every newlywed's fantasy, a rustic secluded lover's paradise- Honeymoon Island. What starts as a weekend of love, turns into a nightmare of blood and terror for three young innocent couples. What lurks in the shadows of Honeymoon Lodge? Is it the caretaker, or perhaps something more fiendish and deadly? Honeymoon Island, where newlyweds joined in holy matrimony spend their wedding night screaming in terror!

Title: Human Highway
description: The new owner of a roadside diner stuck in a town built around an always leaking nuclear power plant plans to torch the place to collect insurance. However, an assortment of bizare characters and weird events (such as spaceships flying around) gets in his way.

Title: Koichiro Uno's Wet and Riding
description: Erotic sex comedy about an unhappy wife turning to partner swapping to satisfy her sexual desire.

Title: As Safadas
description: Tale of three stories. 'Rainha do Fliper' (Pinball's Queen) In the outskirts of São Paulo, Reginéia is the pinball's queen, exploited by her pimp Giba. Out of the blue, her former boyfriend Tenório (a.k.a. Tezinho) comes to the arcade place seeking out Reginéia. She gets close to Tenório and has an argument with the jealous Giba. But Reginéia soon finds how insecure and mediocre Tenório is. 'Uma Aula de Sanfona' (One Class of Accordion) Bank clerk Nanci and her friend Cristina have come from Ribeirão Preto and share an apartment in São Paulo. Nanci has an argument with her lover Valdemar, and goes to her room blaming her upset on the accordian lessons that her neighbor, Durval Pereira, is giving on the floor above. When their electric shower stops working Cristina asks Durval if he can fix it. Meanwhile, Valdemar comes to the apartment and Nanci decides to use her neighbor to make her boyfriend jealous. Nanci teases Durval and they have sex. Nanci becomes infatuated with Durval but when she pays him an unexpected visit she finds that he is not teaching accordion, but he is actually a pedophile. 'Belinha, a Virgem' (Belinha, the Virgin) In São Paulo, the wedding day of the virgin, Belinha is rapidly approaching,. But the wedding is against the will of her fiancé's mother. Belinha is not intimate before the wedding with her fiancé. What he does not know is that she is actually an amoral call girl who exploits old men, while she remains virgin. When her future mother-in-law asks the parochial priest to check whether Belinha is virgin or not, the girl uses her sculptural body to resolve the situation.

Title: Female Teacher: In Front of the Students
description: A young teacher, Reiko, gets a job at a deteriorated high school where her beauty captivates male students. After a brutal assault, she finds a puzzle piece left by the attacker, prompting her quest for answers.

Title: The Forest
description: A cannibal hermit living in the woods preys on campers and hikers for his food supply.

Title: Due gocce d'acqua salata
description: After an airplane crash, two young passengers, a male and a female are left stranded on a tropical desert island.

Title: Boat People
description: A Japanese photojournalist revisits Vietnam after the Liberation and learns harsh truths about its regime and its "New Economic Zones".

Title: Incontro nell'ultimo paradiso
description: Two college students decide to take a vacation to the Amazon. After renting a boat and sailing down the river in search of some good scenery, the two kids become lost.

Title: Boy Meets Girl
description: Parents leave their tween daughter Aya at a kibbutz where the children are housed by age, not gender. Aya has to get used to dealing with other children and to get used to sharing her room with boys. And sharing the showers with them too.

Title: Pals
description: The relationship betwee two best friends from the outskirt of Madrid. When one of them gets the other one's sister pregnant they have to find a way to pay an abortion in order to avoid a conflict with their parents.

Title: Bloody Sect
description: A young woman pregnant with the Anti-Christ is terrorized by a cult of satanists.

Title: The Sword of the Barbarians
description: A swordsman's wife is murdered by followers of the evil Goddess Rani. He vows vengeance upon the cult and journeys to the Ark of the Templars to get a magic crossbow that will help him accomplish his mission.

Title: Goodbye Paradise
description: On Queensland's Gold Coast in the early 1980s, when a disgraced former cop, Michael Stacey writes a book exposing police corruption, does an investigation resulting in 2 murders, exposes a religious cult and watches the army begin a military coup.

Title: La balance
description: Police compel a couple of criminals to become its informants.

Title: The Scorpion with Two Tails
description: Joan has nightmares of Etruscan sacrifices. She knows very well the Etruscan language and her husband Arthur is an archeologist studying Etruscan tombs. In a nightmare she foresees her husband's death. And Arthur is then killed with the same way the Etruscans killed their sacrifice victims.

Title: Bingo Bongo
description: A monkey like man found in the jungles of Congo is brought to Milan, Italy and is called Bingo Bongo. Only Laura, an anthropologist, believes in his human qualities.

Title: Vidhaata
description: When Kunal decides to avenge Abu Baba's death, he discovers his grandfather's true identity and the reason behind his father's death.

Title: Baker County, U.S.A.
description: When a group of college students come across a redneck in the wilderness murdering his wife's lover, they become the objects of his crazed vengeance.

Title: O kamikazi tsantakias
description: To save his delinquent younger brother from the clutches of a dangerous purse-snatching motorcycle gang, an honest and hard-working bachelor summons the courage to do the unthinkable: be one of them. But, will he remember his mission?

Title: Roda, tsanta kai kopana
description: A major hit in the Greek cinemas at the time, this comedy by Omiros Efstratiadis is about a bunch of teenagers who make things difficult for their teachers.

Title: Fair Game
description: Three wealthy schoolgirls escape for a weekend getaway to a remote town, unaware it's been overtaken by psychopaths who stalk and terrorize them, turning their vacation into a horrific nightmare.

Title: Soup for One
description: When Allan meets Maria he is sure he has found the perfect woman for him but she's not interested. He persists, she relents, they begin dating. Allan then starts to second guess what he thought he wanted.

Title: Shakti
description: A scrupulously honest cop refuses kidnappers' demands at grave risk to the life of his son. The son is rescued but lives forever scarred by his father's willingness to sacrifice his own son for the sake of his principles. This works out to devastating effect when the son grows up to be a Mafia don, and his father is assigned the job of bringing him in.

Title: Ten Violent Women
description: Eight women miners get fed up with their lifestyle and decide to try crime. After successfully pulling off a jewelry store robbery, they are busted by narcs when they try to buy cocaine.

Title: Lonely Fifteen
description: Young prostitutes and troubled teenagers.

Title: Ace of Aces
description: In 1936, a French boxer on his way to the Berlin Olympic Games befriends a local Jewish boy and decides to save him from the Nazis.

Title: Bakterion
description: A scientist's experiment with a deadly bacteria goes awry and leaves him horribly deformed. The monstrous man then runs amok in his town.

Title: Starstruck
description: A teenage girl, with dreams of becoming a famous singer, tries to secure a spot on a local televised talent show.

Title: The Emperor Caligula: 'The Untold Story'
description: Caligula's four-year reign and descent into madness are revisited through slanderous vignettes and blunt historical facts.

Title: Le notti segrete di Lucrezia Borgia
description: A thief captures Duke of Riviera, decides to impersonate him and head to Rome.

Title: The Demon
description: Random people are terrorized by a malevolent man wearing a black leather glove with razor-fingers, who brings their worst fears to life.

Title: The Clairvoyant
description: Two uneasy friends, a police officer and a TV talk show host, each pursue the mysterious "handcuff killer" with the aid of an artist who sees - and draws - the killer's crimes before they're committed.

Title: Trick or Treats
description: A baby sitter is stuck watching over a young brat on Halloween night who keeps playing vicious pranks on her. To add to her trouble the boy's deranged father has escaped from an asylum and is planning on making a visit.

Title: Ferat Vampire
description: An unusual vehicle, the vampire-mobile owned by Madam Ferat, draws blood from the driver's foot via a fanged gas pedal, using it as fuel to keep the car running during acceleration.

Title: Pecado Horizontal
description: In a small town, three men meet after 15 years for a wedding and, instead of attending the ceremony, they go to a bar and start remembering the past, along with their sexual adventures.

Title: Runaway Nightmare
description: Two dorky Nevada worm wranglers are kidnapped by a gang of beautiful women as part of a plot to steal plutonium from the Mafia.

Title: Dragon Lord
